title: Hinomori Shizuku — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What a beautiful sunset...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hardly come to this area, and it's so peaceful here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I should really be heading back soon...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The station is just around that corner, so the agency...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Did I not walk past this place a while ago?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
How strange.
I was so sure I would reach the station if I just headed in this direction.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, maybe if I go back the way I came from...hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where did I come from?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll ask someone for directions...
But there's no one here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll call Shii! Ah, but she's probably already started her shift at her part-time job by now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I guess I'll have to figure this out on my own.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It can't possibly be that far away...
Shizuku? What're you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, hello, Airi.
Why are you here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can't you tell? I was asked to buy stuff for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see.
As for me, I was just taking a walk around because the sunset was so lovely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Taking a walk, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm heading back to the agency now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what you say, but this is the complete opposite direction from your agency. You're lost, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Lost? I'm not lost, I just wandered into a place I'm not familiar with while I was walking around...oh, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's like the textbook definition of lost!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I guess you're right...
But, if I just go back the way I came from, I'm sure I'll be fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really? Tell me which way you came from, then.
And where's the train station, while we're at it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let me see, this way...or maybe not. That way?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Or not. This way, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The fact that you keep looking at me for confirmation is the best proof that you're hopelessly lost.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I guess I'm lost...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... You have absolutely no sense of direction, so don't go walking into random roads you're not familiar with.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't just stand there. Hurry up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You'll be fine once we get to the station, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're taking me there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you're on your way back home after shopping, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. I have a lot of things I need to put in the fridge, so hurry up and follow me already.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sheesh... And don't you go wandering off into unfamiliar roads again, like I said just now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't just try your best, make sure it doesn't happen! You haven't learned from your mistake at all!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... Your love for taking walks can be such a pain.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Maybe, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It feels like you've found me again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, let's go, Airi. Um...this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's the opposite way!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: Are all the cleanup committee class representatives here? We're making a zero-waste educational poster today. Please work with a partner to come up with a design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a pleasure to be working together, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes!
The pleasure's all mine, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm really glad we're working together on this.
The truth is, I'm quite terrible at drawing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You are? But, I'm not very confident about my drawing skills either, so let's help each other out, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course! Let's see... We should think of a design first.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
Maybe we can start by drawing out what we have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We may find something good by exchanging ideas like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This should do.
Are you done, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...sort of.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's share, then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I drew someone picking up litter and putting it in the trash can. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, that's really good!
It's so easy to understand!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad you think so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Since it's supposed to be an educational poster, having something easy to understand is definitely the way to go. Let's use your design for the poster!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I haven't seen your design yet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, m-my design?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: P-Promise you won't laugh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? I won't.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... I was also trying to draw someone picking up trash from the floor...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Uh huh.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why is there an octopus here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ugh... This is the person picking up the trash...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What about this heap of rice cakes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-That's the trash...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is amazing, Honami!
Your art is so abstract. You're like Picasso!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm not an art person so I don't know why, but...
This design just draws me in somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
My eyes are just naturally attracted to the artwork.
This should catch people's attention easily.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I've never seen such a wonderful design before.
Let's go with this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I-I-I don't think that's a good idea!
Yours is definitely better!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I disagree.
Your design is very evocative.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I-I have to dissuade her somehow! Much as it saddens me to admit it, this bizarre drawing of mine is just no proper material for a poster!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Well... This educational poster is going to be seen by a lot of people!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, that's true.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means Shiho will definitely see it too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My sweet Shii!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wouldn't you like Shiho to see a poster that was designed by you? It'll be a great conversation starter!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... Are you really sure we should go with mine?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Absolutely! Like I said just now, an educational poster should be easy to understand above all else!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I mean, just look around!
Everyone else is going with something that's easy to understand too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
We'll combine my layout and your art style to—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-That won't do!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ah! I-I mean...
That won't do because it completely changes the overall mood.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does it? I was thinking Shii would be more open to talking if the poster incorporated both of our designs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I don't think...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In any case, I want to thank you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I love spending time in this committee because I can chat with you at leisure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Besides, you always share with me things about Shii that I never knew before.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She seldom talks about school or her friends, you see. But she does listen when I talk about certain things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Like when I'm talking about the committee activities I do with you, Honami. She listens really attentively then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please continue to be her friend, and, if you don't mind, to lend her a listening ear too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Maybe...someday...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hi... Look at you, grinning like you've just won something. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? Do I look unusually happy?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're beaming your happiness all around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It must be because of the dream I had last night.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Was it that good?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I dreamed about back when I was in training.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To become an idol?

rows.Speaker: Idol Candiate A
rows.Line: There are other girls better than her at dancing and singing...

rows.Speaker: Idol Candiate B
rows.Line: She gets preferential treatment only because of her pretty face.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku had to endure jealous girls saying nasty things about her back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's to like about dreaming of that time in your life?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At first, I thought it would be a bad dream too, but it developed into something nice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It started with another trainee idol being mean to me, and then I was left tied up on a floating island in the middle of a swimming pool, and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on, what did you just say?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was left tied up on a floating island in the middle of a swimming pool.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's so totally random.
A floating island? In a POOL? And on top of that, you were tied up?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (On second thought, that's not too far off from what I had to undergo in those variety shows...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Well, I guess dreams can be crazy like that, huh.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, what happened after?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was feeling helpless, but then Happy Everyday, the Masked Variety Idol, came to my rescue!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, whaaat! It can't be...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She was magnificent!
She leaped high up in the air and was just about to reach me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But just as she was making that last jump to get to you, she slipped and fell into the pool?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh... How did you know my dream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because that's exactly what happened in one of the variety shows I appeared in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I knew it seemed familiar, somehow. So that's why.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You only realized that now?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. So that's where the name came from, Happy Everyday, the Masked Variety Idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't really want to hear that name ever again!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But going back to my dream...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, stop! I don't want to know!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's not go back to it, ever!
You'd better go to your desk and get ready for class.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I haven't finished—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You don't need to!
Shoo! Back to your desk!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I was just getting to the best part...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In my dream, Airi slips and falls into the pool, like she said...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But she resolutely swims back to the shore of the island and unties me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She then says, No matter how uncertain or tough things get, keep looking forward!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi has always been showing me the way forward. Back when I was a trainee idol, and when I quit it for a while.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I owe it to her to become a wonderful idol she can be proud of.)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was a good session.
Next week, we can dance the entire song.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And from there, we'll keep perfecting our choreography.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They're talking about it as if everything was fine, but I still can't do this dance well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I made so many mistakes in my steps, and I couldn't follow what everyone else was doing...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hey, Minori. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh well... I'll have to practice the parts I'm no good with at home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I got a message?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Who's it from? Oh...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sorry for calling you out to practice with me some more...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's no problem at all.
I also wanted to work on that dance a bit more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are Airi and Haruka not coming?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't ask them to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They've got this dance down to a T, so I didn't want to bother them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Er... I-I wasn't trying to say your dancing wasn't so good, nothing like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, it's okay. I know that I didn't do so well today. Let's work on improving together, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes. Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Maybe I shouldn't have kept this secret from Haruka and Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. It's understandable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You didn't want to disappoint Haruka, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... Were you thinking the same?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Almost. I want to make Airi proud.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So let's make this our top secret special drill.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Top secret special drill? That's got a cool ring to it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Are you ready to begin?
Let's surprise Haruka and Airi tomorrow by dancing perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Five, six, seven, eight!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
It always goes downhill towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think it's because you don't shift weight the right way and it adds up over time until you fall out of step.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aah, is that what's going on? I'll be more careful!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, did you notice what I'm doing wrong? It seems to me that my transition between moves isn't as crisp as it should be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... You perform every part of the choreography with a lot of care...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that could be why your movements don't seem crisp!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka told me that you need to vary the tempo to make each part more distinctive!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That could be it.
I'll pay more attention to changes in the tempo.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good luck! Let's try again from the start!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huff... Oof...
I think we're getting there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's all coming together—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Told you they'd be here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We sensed there was something odd about you two after practice, so we came here on a hunch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You looked like you were beating yourselves up over not quite getting the dance steps.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So you two are having a private practice session, is that it? Haruka, what should we do with them?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's have them show us the dance moves they practiced without us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's see if you've made any progress!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm happy to do so!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's getting dark, so you only have one try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's going to be enough! Let's do this, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, you need to move faster to keep up with the timing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, good afternoon, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're sweating a lot, Minori.
Were you practicing your routine?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, but it's not going very well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's why I'm teaching her.
Alright, Minori, enough talking. Get back to practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, ma'am!
One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're slowing down again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I used to be really bad at shifting my weight like that too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? You too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I was terrible before my debut and destroyed quite a few pairs of dance shoes because of that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had to change practice outfits so many times throughout the day, I ended up with a stack of them... Eventually, I developed my very own routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's amazing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, that means I have to practice hard enough to develop two routines!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's that got to do with anything?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: T-True...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, stop talking and get back to practice already! Are you really serious about mastering the moves?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I am! Alright, here goes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori is working so hard...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It took me quite a while before I was finally able to master dance moves like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I couldn't get it right no matter how hard I practiced, and I was about to give up out of frustration, until...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you staring at me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Minori.
I really wanted to help you practice, but I have to go to work now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please don't worry about me and enjoy your work, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do your best, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'll see you both tomorrow.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line:
Okay, that's all for the shoot today.
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad everything went smoothly...
Thank you, too.

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line: All the photos we took today were fantastic. I can't decide which one to use as cover...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: What about this one?

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line: Hm... I think her face can be seen clearer in the composition of this one here, though.

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line: Gosh, she's so good-looking.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone is complimenting me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But they're only talking about my appearance...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I understand that looks are important as an idol, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The idol I really want to be is...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's practicing the same dance moves today too. While I do hope she can become an idol one day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She'll have to see and go through many things behind the scenes that are quite unsavory, and that may cause her to lose hope...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Just like how Airi lost hope...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah! Hello, Hinomori!
Are you here to watch me today, too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I was thinking of practicing together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'm really happy to have you join me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Still, I don't know why but...
When I look at her, I can't help but want to cheer her on.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's practice hard together, Minori.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think we're quite coordinated on this part now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Our practice sessions bore fruit!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you've gotten much better at the moves you were having trouble with.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, it feels so nice to be complimented by Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I'll have to work harder too, so that I can dance as well as Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do this part together again when Airi can join us for practice next time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay! Then our next...
Wait, what? It's already so late?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Time really flies when you're enjoying yourself...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's stop here for today and get ready to go back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka, Shizuku.
Can I ask for your advice about something?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it? I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, what advice do you need?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I want to know...
What should I do in order to become an idol that's acknowledged by everyone?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Acknowledged... As in?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to be acknowledged by not just fellow group members, but everyone who watches our shows as well!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's quite a difficult goal to reach...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I thought so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There are many different ways to receive acknowledgement from others, but what made you think about this in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, it's because Haruka said I was a true idol too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was super happy when she said that to me, so I started wanting to have more and more people acknowledge me as a true idol to feel that happiness again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I see.

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Line: People praised me, but only because of my looks...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I think I must have started feeling that way because I had lost sight of the image of the ideal idol I wanted to become.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh... You have a lot going on in your life too, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The ideal idol I want to become...

rows.Line: Sure. I think I would've been much more helpful but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You dummy...

rows.Line: There's no point in putting so much thought into what-if scenarios.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We know what our next goal is, right?

What do you want to do?

rows.Line: I want the four of us to become idols together as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:

rows.Line: I was just trying to encourage you to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're the one that won the entire audition and I didn't want you moping around just because of some dumb rumors.

rows.Line: Right. I was still new to everything back then, having a hard time with the dance routines and causing problems for the other girls.

rows.Line: I was so upset with myself that I cried a lot for not being able to do anything right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku

rows.Line: You even did the same thing when I decided to quit.

rows.Line: You got so mad that you rushed into the Cheerful * Days theatre on your own.

rows.Line: Hehe. I don't think I'll ever forget that.

rows.Line: I hate the fact that I know exactly how you feel...

rows.Line: That's right! I was just as jealous as you are! Jealous of Shizuku's looks and the fact that she was so special!

rows.Line: I admit I was upset that she was always chosen over me no matter how much effort I put in!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: All we did was start sulking in our own jealousy. She's nothing like us!

rows.Line: I'm never ever forgetting what happened that day...

rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Line: You weren't seeing me as Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days, but you saw me for who I was.

rows.Line: I think that was what made me the happiest.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Line: I've been you work so hard since the very beginning. I was actually really proud when you finally made your debut.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I was irritated at the same time that you got so far ahead of me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I really was happy to see all of your hard work slowly start to pay off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:

As much for the fans as for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Line:

We're all in this together!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: This time, let's make sure to become the idols we want to be.

rows.Line: The kind of idols who are able to give everyone around them hope for tomorrow!

rows.Line: Of course! That's what MORE MORE JUMP! is all about!

rows.Line: I'm so sorry for all the trouble I caused everyone with our other video. I didn't mean to make you all worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You were just trying your hardest to show everyone the real you!

rows.Line: Thank you, Minori. But that doesn't change the fact that I made everyone worry about me.

rows.Line: So, I'm very sorry. Also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...!

rows.Line:
Minori, Airi, Haruka. I know I can be a handful...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm just glad you came to a decision you're happy with.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Let's keep doing what we can, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Line: You're really raring to go, aren't you?!

rows.Line: Still, let's take a look at what you have. Which one of these was your favorite idea, Shizuku?

rows.Line: Well, let me see...

rows.Line: (Discussing the best way to promote ourselves like this sure feels strange...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Up until now, I only ever had to follow whatever plans the agency came up with for me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's thanks to them that the Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days was born and had so many adoring fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But from now on, I want to be the real me. I want them to support me as Shizuku Hinomori of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Line: If I were to pick one, it would probably be the one where we each introduce our own personal techniques for practicing.

rows.Line: Or how Airi and I have slightly different voice training methods and such.

rows.Line: I imagine there's a lot we don't know about one another's personal foibles when it comes to practicing alone, no?

rows.Line: So we can watch videos of each other for the first time alongside the fans to show them our genuine reactions.

rows.Line: That would work since we stream our videos live. It might make it feel a little more like a concert too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true!

rows.Line: If we do it this way, we can each have some dedicated time in the spotlight.

rows.Line: And I think it'll be a particularly good way for the fans to learn more and more about Minori.

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line: I want everyone to learn more and more about Minori as well.

rows.Line: Shizuku... Haruka...

rows.Line: It'll be a great way to encourage everyone to participate!

rows.Line: Oh! That's right!

rows.Line: Hehe. If Minori is this excited about it, I'm sure that means the fans will want to watch it as well.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: *Sigh*... Why wasn't I born with a face like that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (All those times I felt so ashamed of myself after being told so many awful things by everyone, I ended up running from practice...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But Minori just...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Minori's probably just...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I am worried about her.
I need to go and talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm sure she'll feel a lot better if we're there with her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Gasp*...! Wait, you two!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right now, I think we should give her a little more time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If it were me in her shoes, I'd want you to be there to tell me that everything will be okay but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think Minori's stronger than that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Stronger? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even after what happened, she tried to laugh it off, didn't she?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She was doing everything she could to make sure our stream didn't go awry, so she smiled and laughed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I couldn't imagine myself doing that, especially if I were just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get what you're trying to say, but for your own sake, please don't be so self-deprecating like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't mind me. That's not what I meant by that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think Shizuku is trying to say that Minori will find her own way out of this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. She may be crying all by herself right now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But those tears will surely find a way to turn into hope and encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe that she needs those tears because she'll find a way to use them like a springboard to stand right back up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And keep moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. That's why I think we should believe in her and trust that she can find her own way through this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You might be right about us going to see her now. She could take it as us not believing in her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. So let's put our faith in her. I'm sure she'll be back to her usual, smiling self tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree with Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess I was more concerned about her than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're all in this together, so we hardly blame you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I was about to throw what she did away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, Shizuku, do you have a second...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I keep talking about stuff that happened when we were still in training, but the past is the past. Let's focus on the present, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've both come a long way since then, so it's time to stand up and spread your wings as Shizuku Hinomori of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, a cat...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Aww, it's so cute! No, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's right, you're allergic!
Are you okay, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: As long as I stay about this far away...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I wish you could enjoy this too, Airi.
Hello, Mr. Kitty Cat.

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meeoow?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it tilted its head.
Then how about I... Meeoow?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
S-S-Shizuku! Your tea!
It's gonna get all over your clothes...!!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How strange. The first-year classroom should be around here but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, are you a first year by chance?
I'm looking for Class 1-A. Would you mind showing me where it is?
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Whoa, it's Hinomori's big sis!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Maybe she's here to see Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii! Minori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ugh... Could you not yell our names out like that while barging in...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's let her off this one time.
But what brings you to our class, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm letting you know that I may not be able to come to practice today because of committee work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought I should hand this to you while I still had the chance...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-This bag's really heavy...
Can we look inside?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a book about voice training!
And some notebooks too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're all books I read and notes I took for practice when I was just starting out as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was wondering if these might be of some help to you as well when you're not sure where to go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! These are full of tips and tricks that I'd like to try!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But are you sure about giving these to me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unlike Airi and Haruka, I'm not very good at giving pinpoint answers or detailed advice, but I thought I could at least help you like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My hope is that these will be useful to you as well, so there's no need to hesitate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thank you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but this book seems a little more advanced than the others. This looks pretty difficult...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everything I learned online, plus everything I learned from you and the others, only included the basics. Can I really learn these things...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry, Minori. I believe you'll have a much easier time than you think, especially now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I do. I hope you'll give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay!
I'll take good care of them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there's also something else I wanted to do, if it's alright?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to have lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, lunch?
Minori and I already ate...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Duh. Can't you see break's already half over?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That seems rather strange. I left my class as soon as the bell rang...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You got lost again, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, you put yourself through all that to give me your books and notes...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll join you! We can have lunch together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That settles that then. I'll leave you two to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, Shiho! Wait!
Let's all go together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really want to hear about what you two are like at home too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then I really don't want to go...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it'd be the first time we all had lunch together too...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho, please! I promise to buy you a cream puff or an éclair later so...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's fine. I don't really like sweets anyway.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Pleeease...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I never knew that Minori and Shii were so close.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If you don't come, you'll make Shizuku skip her lunch and go through her classes this afternoon on an empty stomach...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, yes. Poor her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, please...! Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi...
I was just thinking about this upcoming Sunday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You know, how we all agreed yesterday to take a break from our usual practice?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, you did.
Haruka even said she wants to go, so why's it bothering you now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's the thing...
I'm just not sure if Haruka will really be able to enjoy herself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're really saying this now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, if you keep feeling this way, there's no way Haruka's gonna be able to have any fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been trying to come up with ways to help Haruka relax and have fun, but I have nothing so far...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what this is really about?
Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I doubt Haruka actually maintains her perfect idol persona 24/7.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like... Oh, during the Sports Festival!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even though she was super busy with committee stuff, she still had a good time with her classmates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. She even celebrated with her friends in the end after the big relay too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See? She might be more of a normal girl than we think without us really knowing it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess what I'm trying to say is that we just need to give her those kinds of opportunities to show it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see... Thank you, Airi.
I'm getting a much better picture now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, of course...
I should talk to Minori too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She spends the most amount of time with Haruka, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My guess is that talking to her may give me an even clearer picture.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But what about Haruka?
You gonna talk to her too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, not right now.
I'd rather not cause a fuss by making her think that there may be something wrong.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that should probably be fine then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How about I go with you?
Knowing you, your conversation won't end in time for our next class.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate it, Airi.
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There she is! Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm? Airi and Shizuku?
Do you need me for something?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how we talked about going out together this Sunday? Airi and I were hoping to discuss something concerning it with you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But how do I explain this to her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I shouldn't start by saying that I'm worried about Haruka, but I may not be able to learn how to have Haruka relax without saying so...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're going out, but didn't really decide on where we'd go or what we'd do and stuff, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So we'd like to pick your brain a little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Okay, okay. Just calm down for now.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You wanted to go do some karaoke, shop and grab some dessert, right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I want to do cheers for you guys while you sing, and we can sing songs together that we usually don't!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As for shopping, I thought that it'd be fun to come up with new outfits for each other!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And dessert...
Hehe. That's just me wanting to have some sweets and chat like regular girls.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like that too. It sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which do you think out of all those will Haruka enjoy doing the most?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, it's probably best if we find stuff that we can all enjoy, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree! Which one will be the most fun for Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... Okay...
I think sweets then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but she can't have anything sugary right now, so she probably won't be able to have much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. She loves sweets!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She does! Oh, but the other day when we were heading home together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We talked about how it's not always good to hold back like that, and we ended up getting some cream puffs together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then she decided to get two of pretty much everything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, seriously?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No joke! Thankfully, two of everything meant one for each of us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, you had me going there for a second. I actually thought you meant she got that all for herself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But she really loves sweets, doesn't she?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It goes way beyond that!
But I never realized Haruka had that side to her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
You two went to Phoenix Wonderland together the other day too, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We did! Haruka and I had lots of fun together there too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We went on a bunch of rides, met Phenny and even took some pictures with him!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Phenny!
Shii absolutely adores him!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does that mean Haruka likes him too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think so. Probably because he looks so much like a penguin.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, crap! Sorry, Minori, we gotta head back soon!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for your input! You've been a huge help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're very welcome! I'll see you again after school!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... Made it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We did, but I'm also glad that we took this opportunity to talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe we found just what Haruka needs to relax and enjoy herself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. She wouldn't do something like ordering all those cream puffs otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm feeling much more hopeful now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. Let's try out what we can this Sunday, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is nice to stretch outside when it's so sunny out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku. Good morning. You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I decided to come a little early to stretch since it's such a nice day out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like to join me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't mind? I think I will then.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, before we start...
I need to thank you for yesterday, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were genuinely worried about me, right? I thought I should thank you for showing that much concern.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you don't need to do that. We're all in this together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. True.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But there's also one other thing that I'd like to ask about us moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I was wondering how or when you're able to just be yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It still doesn't feel natural to me yet, so I was hoping to learn a little more from you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, if you're okay with me that is...!
So let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you know...
I may not serve as a very good reference.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm the type that just lets their true personality show and ends up making everyone else follow suit...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... We even talked before about how you really are just yourself, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But when we're doing streams and walking around town, I do try to keep in mind that I am still an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I don't tend to maintain that persona while at home or at school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're close with some other girls in your class too, no? Like Ichika and Saki in particular.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am. Those two never saw me as an idol from the start. They only saw me as their classmate and I can't thank them enough for it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, now I understand. It just means that I feel at ease around them compared to when I'm with other people...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So that means An too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's this other girl who goes to a different school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've known her since before I became an idol and she hasn't changed one bit since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really...?
I'm happy to hear that you have a friend like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku. I'm starting to get a better idea of how to relax and just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, also... You said you're the type that just lets their personality show. Can you give me an example of when that happens?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I imagine it happens to most when I'm with Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think it has to do with how I'm not an idol to her, but her big sister.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you think of anything else...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! When I'm doing homework with Airi or talking about sweets with her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Schoolwork definitely has that effect.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our favorite foods too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, Minori mentioned something about cream puffs earlier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: About how you and her went somewhere together, and got two of everything on the menu.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. I remember now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Training and eating right are cornerstones of becoming better as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Minori taught me that time that it's also important to do what we like in order to achieve those sorts of goals.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In hindsight, I do think that I was pushing myself a little too hard that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also didn't realize that I'd have to try this hard just to relax or be myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm guessing how you simply love being an idol has a lot to do with that, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I admire that part of you so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll try to be more careful from now on... Promise to tell me when you think I'm overdoing it again in the future?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Learning how to support my friends and be there for them when they need me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to keep growing as an idol to do that.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because she takes being an idol so seriously and loves it so much, she even made me want to work a little harder.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it's so sad that others don't get to see that side of her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything we can do for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, what if we tried this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (A solo performance by Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We're pretty certain that the students at the elementary school already know all about her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we also want her to sing, dance and interact with them to show everyone that she's an idol in every sense of the word.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If everybody gets a chance to see Airi performing as an idol, I'm sure their view of her will change dramatically.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to do everything I can to help make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I may even be in a position to ensure that things go well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay...
That should be everything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I still have some of the business cards that I was given.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But my manager always dealt with any official business... And I don't have many business cards left myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (No, that doesn't matter now. I want Airi to sing that song...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's been locked away in the record company's vaults ever since Airi's agency decided to change her image...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She was really looking forward to singing it too...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It might even be one of the biggest reasons why she feels like she wasn't seen as a real idol back then.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The writers likely possess the rights to the song, so I'll start by looking them up...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Let's see... The business cards of the people involved in the music side of things are...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, here! I'll start with this one...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, this is Shizuku Hinomori. I apologize in advance for disturbing you so late at night. I'd like to talk to you about...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, it's starting to get dark and this seems like a good place to stop, so why don't we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... We did so much again today...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But your stamina's improved so much! Your dance moves were spot on towards the end there too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haruka, do you have a moment?
It's about Airi's solo performance...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, how are things going?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, I need you to do me a favor.
The next day

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning, Shizuku. You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Good morning, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thank you so much for introducing me to all those people from the music business yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't mention it. All I did was ask them if it'd be okay for me to give you their contact information, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what really surprised me was how the writer you've been looking for doesn't seem to have their own website or any sort of social media presence.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that just seems to be the way they operate. As a result, I kept running into dead ends in terms of reaching them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I know that they're still writing songs, so I knew there had to be a way to reach them! I promise to return with good news!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. I'll continue helping you in whatever ways I can too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much for doing this, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I need to take this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, this is Shizuku Hinomori.
Again, I apologize for disturbing you so late at night yesterday... What?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You know someone who can contact them...?! Yes... Yes... Okay, I'll do that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I can't thank you enough!
I promise to return this favor soon.
Okay, bye.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, was that...?
Diner

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm Shizuku Hinomori.
I believe it's been quite a while since we last met.

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: Yes, it has.

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: Not since I was asked to write songs for Cheerful * Days after you became the lead, I believe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I need to thank you for what you did for us back then.

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: No, thank you. I'm glad we're able to meet like this again too. Oh, but word is that you had some trouble reaching me...

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: I'm sorry for putting you through all that. It's sort of my own fault for not having my work information publicly listed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I know you're a very busy person, so I appreciate how you agreed to meet with me like this on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Now, um... About why we're here...
There's something I'd like to discuss with you...

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line:
Yes, I've been briefed on your situation.
This is about that song I wrote for Airi Momoi, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Would it be possible for MORE MORE JUMP! to use it during our next stream?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're scheduled to perform at an event involving elementary schoolers and...

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: I see. And you want her to sing that song...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know that Airi has several fond memories of her time with QT, but she's also talked to me about her regrets and various other hurdles she had to face.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not being able to sing the song you wrote may be one of her biggest regrets.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Singing this song will mark the start of a new chapter in her story as an idol, and more importantly, as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want our fans, her fans, to see her on stage. I want them to see her as Airi Momoi the idol!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please, I beg you!

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line:
There's no need to beg.
I understand how you feel very much, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: I've actually had an opportunity to see some MORE MORE JUMP! streams...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You have...?

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: Hehe. Isn't it only natural since you and Momoi are both members, and I wrote songs for you two?

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: Also, I don't actually sing the songs I write, so I have a vested interest in supporting those who do end up singing them...

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: It seems that Momoi not getting a chance to sing the song I wrote for her has been bothering me this whole time...

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: It's meant to be a direct reflection of her personality. I was certain that I was able to capture how she's both cute but strong, so I'd be honored if...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: D-Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Writer
rows.Line: Yes. I'd be incredibly relieved and beyond ecstatic if she sang it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! Thank you so very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I did it... I did it, Airi!
You finally get to sing that song!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I should let Haruka and Minori know too! After that, we'll need to get the original files and have Airi start practicing right away...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Her performance needs to be as big a success as we can possibly make it!)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See you next time, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did great today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You especially, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you were on a roll during our talk segment!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. You also segued us between segments so smoothly and made so many funny comments.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm the talker for the group, right?
It's my job to make everything sound interesting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. She's finally back to being her old self.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She really had me worried for a moment there...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka and I had another look at the messages the students from that school sent us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we came across one student who seemed very interested in when you were on all those variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You felt concerned after reading this, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were wondering if that message dredged up some unpleasant memories...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I knew this entire time that Airi was still bothered by what she experienced when she was on all those variety shows...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And my actions show that I didn't do enough to take her feelings into consideration.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I even brought up Happy Everyday with her during numerous conversations...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It must've been so hard for her to hear that name coming out of my mouth.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She seems much better now, but...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey...
Earth to Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Y-Yes, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: About us doing an after-party...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An after-party? Oh, to celebrate how the graduation event went...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It would've been nice to do this sooner, but I thought we should celebrate since this was the first offer we received as MMJ.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How about it, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Great, then we're all set!
Hehe. I can't wait!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Welcome, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting me over.
Sorry if it feels like I'm here all the time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's always my pleasure to have you over.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, I should tell Airi before Haruka and Minori get here...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still haven't thanked you for what you did, have I, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thanking me? For what?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For getting permission to use that song during the event. I heard that it caused you a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not even in my wildest dreams did I ever think that I'd get a chance to sing that song. I can't thank you enough, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I also want to thank the person you talked to about this. Can you get me in touch with them?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
They mentioned that they'd like to talk to you as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great! Ideally, I'd like to thank them in person. You think that's possible?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you can leave that to me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But there's something I'd like to discuss with you as well, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I... I'm so sorry...
About Happy Everyday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I knew what you went through while you were on those variety shows still bothered you, but I still kept bringing it up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Looking back, I feel awful about what I said and did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Is that what this is about?
Don't worry, you big dope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You watched my shows every time they aired and you really enjoyed them, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, absolutely!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See? So quit being such a worrywart.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If anything, I started feeling a little embarrassed each time after I found out that you were watching on the other end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, Haruka and Minori should be here soon, so why don't we start setting up for our party?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind if I borrow your kitchen, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're more than welcome to, and I'd like to help as well!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, Shizuku, we'll leave the planning for our moon viewing stream up to you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're really doing a moon viewing...
I've never had many opportunities to actually do one, so I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you haven't?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, I've made dango with my family before, but we never really did much more than that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We usually just bought a bunch of traditional sweets and made an event out of it, so that was usually pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After I started learning how to cook, my dad, big sister and I began making dango from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really are an incredible cook, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. If you want any help with dango dishes, just ask me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll get that chance to show us your skills.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, they're going to be invaluable!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do either of you have any nice moon viewing memories, Haruka, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm in the same boat as Minori, so I can't say that I do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, I've sort of celebrated through some segments of TV programs and events where I interacted with my fans.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I remember watching those!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But in terms of normal moon viewings, I didn't do much other than trying to see the rabbit on the moon when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii and I also used to do that when we were little!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I even remember Shii trying to stretch up as high as she could to feed some dango to the rabbit on the moon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She even kept wondering if they were eating dango like we were during our moon viewing parties, so she seems to value them quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. That's so cute of her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, she really is!
I wish I could just show you...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay, maybe later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what about you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me? Well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One time, during this moon viewing party we had during kindergarten, I made rabbit-shaped dango with Shii.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Rabbit-shaped dango?
That sounds adorable!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, they turned out very well.
Shii was actually the one who showed me how to make them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She showed you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we started out in different groups, but we ended up making them together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, some of the other children kept telling her that she should follow the teachers' instructions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's pretty natural to believe everything grown-ups say when you're little, but your sister's so creative!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She really is. Which is why I wanted her to make her dango just the way she likes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sadly, she ended up all alone and I drifted back towards her without even thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was when I asked her if we could make them together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so adorable♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is! You can even tell how Shiho's personality hasn't changed since she was little!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's still a bit of a lone wolf, but she's always been a very strong individual.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, uh... It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Anyway, thank you all so much!
It was so nice to hear about all of your wonderful memories♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, this was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It might even be nice to talk about these experiences for one of your streams♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
It's not every day that you get to hear about what an idol was like when they were little...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna hear more and more about what you were like, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can't you just ask her yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I see what you mean...
It doesn't have to be just us either. We can ask our fans about their childhoods too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's a good idea. We can make an event out of it through the comments sections.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we've pretty much got this one in the bag!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and thanks to all of you, I have a feeling that it'll go over very well with everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's unfortunate that I won't get to do a moon viewing with Shii...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But our childhood memories may just come in handy for this stream.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can for our viewers on the other side of the camera...)
After the Moon Viewing Party
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And, there we go...
My room's all cleaned up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thankfully the others helped me out a little before they left, so there wasn't much left to do.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, let's see how Shiho's doing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku, I'm done with the dishes.
Need any help here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii!
I actually just finished cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone being kind enough to help us out really sped things up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I was thinking about putting on a kettle now that my room's nice and clean.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like to join me for some tea, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Normally, she'll say she needs to practice on her bass and go back to her room...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, that sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: R-Really, Shii?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, huh? What's wrong?
Why are you so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I didn't expect you to say yes is all...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll go boil some water now!
No, I should lay out some floor cushions first...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You just put them away.
You're really gonna take them back out now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Okay, please wait while I get the tea ready! I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's really no need to hurry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting, Shii!
I'm back with the tea. It's very hot so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Today's party was so much fun.
Making and having dango together, viewing the moon...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And Momoi's such a great cook. The dango dishes she made were so good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Her recipes never do disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I feel like there was a lot more sauce used for the dango during our party than during your stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, about that!
We had everything ready, but ran out of time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hold on, did you just say...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does that mean you watched our stream, Shii?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku, keep it down.
The neighbors might hear us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: O-Oh, right, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hadn't actually seen one yet, so it seemed like a good opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But who mixes up a dango recipe with an ohagi one? You're lucky Kiritani and Momoi were there to save you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even when you were making rabbit masks, every comment was directed towards a certain someone because of how funny their mask looked.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Y-You saw that too...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you talked about me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
Some of our viewers wanted to hear one of us tell a moon viewing story, so...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Are you mad...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, just a little embarrassed.
I'd prefer it if you didn't talk about stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But at the same time, I was kind of happy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When we were little, including during the moon viewing party in kindergarten, you always looked out for me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't realize it back then, but it seems like you were always there for me back then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A long time ago, when I was going through a bit of a tough time, Shii encouraged me by just being the hard-working girl that she is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She gave me the courage to stand back up and try again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'd like it if she would tell me when something's wrong or if she needs my help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's given me so much already, so I want to give back to her somehow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I never knew that you felt that way about me, so I'm glad I know now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She hardly ever says anything like this...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, I...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wah...!
Don't throw yourself at me like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm just so happy that I have a wonderful sister like you in my life, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Knowing that, I can't help but hug you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I think I'll go take a bath now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we take one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Stop right there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
But what if we slept...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (To be fair, this is the most time we've spent together in quite some time...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We can take a bath and sleep in the same bed some other time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nope. Neither are happening.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, good night.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. Good night, Shii.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This seems like a good place to stop, so why don't we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great work today, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree. Very nice work.
Anyway, I need to head off right away today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Got somewhere to go?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, my mother asked me to do something for her... It has to do with this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, it's a ticket for a drawing at the mall!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I remember seeing that recently. You can win a TV and a trip to some hot springs, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A drawing...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this ticket says this is the last day to use it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know, but my mother's busy with work and asked me to go in her place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you make it there on your own?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll be fine, Airi.
I've gone to the mall plenty of times before.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, but that doesn't mean you know where you're supposed to turn this ticket in, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was planning to stay and practice a little more, but maybe I should go with you instead...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I couldn't ask you to do that.
It's just a drawing so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't I go with you♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: L-Luka? You will...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes♪ If I go, Airi can stay and practice, no? Not only that, we'd be reducing the likelihood of you getting lost.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right. I'd feel much better if she went with you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thank you for volunteering like this, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope you win something, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Wish me luck!
Drawing Area

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm glad we found this place without much issue♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I really appreciate it, Luka. I had no trouble finding my way through the mall.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<You're very welcome♪
Truth be told, I was curious about what this “drawing” would be like.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Let's see...>

rows.Line: White means a consolation prize.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
