rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku.
I don't mind talking while we're at school, but a little less physical contact would be nice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for celebrating my birthday like this, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
All these kind words...
I couldn't be happier...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so happy and blushing with joy♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that didn't sound quite right?
Did I mean, “Bursting with joy”...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm not sure what else to say in this situation... Hehe. Let's just leave it there for now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm just glad you understand how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I promise to keep doing everything I can to spread and inspire hope in others as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to your support!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
There, finished...
The first of many monogrammed handkerchiefs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. Embroidering's so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And this really means something since we're giving these to the staff for helping us with our event.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Presents for the staff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because they're not just staff. They're also our fans, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A part of them may still want to enjoy the event as members of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But they raised their hands to help us instead, so I want to give back to them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's a great idea!
Do you already know what you want to give them?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, handkerchiefs.
I was thinking about monogramming them with their initials along with a little clover.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: E-Embroidered personally by you, Shizuku?! Oh, they're absolutely gonna love that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There aren't that many of them, but are you sure you're gonna have enough time...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will. I should be able to work on them at school during breaks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, you seem set.
We should do something too while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I was about to suggest the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
Hehe. What should we get them?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I have a feeling that Airi and the others are coming up with ideas for presents right now.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... I was planning to ask about our food situation alongside my present idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll make sure to ask them tomorrow so we can discuss what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone's going to be incredibly busy, and hungry too, so it might be nice to bring something we can eat on the go...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, all the Cheerful * Days events were fully catered...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But eating food that's been ordered out or prepared elsewhere won't carry the same meaning...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know we can't make that much for them, but I'd like it if we could make something that can also be an expression of our gratitude...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... Something simple that symbolizes our appreciation for them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's it...!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, Shizuku, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You seem awfully happy today.
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I had this wonderful idea yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'd like to talk to all of you about rice balls!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Rice balls...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! O-Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
I didn't mean to start with that part...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, as a little gift...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So you want to make some rice balls for them as a little pick-me-up for when they get hungry?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's an amazing idea!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean... G-Getting a rice ball from Haruka that she made herself...! I wouldn't know what to do with myself...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for everything, Minori.
Here's a rice ball made personally by me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought only about you while making this in the hopes that you'd eat it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It even has salmon in it since I heard it's your favorite. Won't you try some?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here, open wide.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Her delusion might've short-circuited her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She's this happy about it, so it might just be worth a try, no?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not like we need a stove or anything, so the four of us should be able to make more than enough for the whole staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'll be a nice motivational boost for them too, and help them get ready for the show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Such a big boost that some might even collapse from sheer happiness...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, what ingredients should we use?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have quite a few options to choose from... Salmon, bonito and plums come to mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, those all sound delicious♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Delicious? But we're not the ones...
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for gathering here today, everyone. Shall we start making some rice balls?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really wasn't expecting us to set aside time to practice making rice balls like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Truth be told, the rest of us aren't as good at cooking as you are, Airi, so I'm glad we're doing this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi! Haruka!
We have everything from salmon, bonito, plums to tuna salad!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, we got it. Anyway, let's just start by making one of each, and I'll also check to see how you guys do.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay... Make a nice triangle and...
There! Airi, I'm done!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that looks great!
But I think you compressed it a little too much. Try to relax more so that it comes out lighter and fluffier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... That might be easier said than done.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't quite get my triangle to maintain its shape when I try to fluff it up...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too. It starts to fall apart whenever I try to use a lighter grip.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lemme see... Haruka, you should be fine as long as you keep an eye on how you're holding yours.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for you, Minori... I'm guessing that you're putting too many things into your rice ball, so you should probably cut back there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right. Haha...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, would you mind showing us an example?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An example? Sure, but it's probably not gonna look as pretty as you're expecting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, don't force it into becoming a triangle. That'll just make you tense up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As long as it looks vaguely like a little mountain of rice on your hands, then it'll start taking shape on its own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that's why your grip is so important too. Remember, light and fluffy! If you hold it too tightly, you'll crush it by squeezing all the air out of it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So try to be gentle. Hold it like this without letting the air out... One, two, three and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There we go! Done!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! That was so fast! It looks really pretty too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you can't get it in three turns, try to work in sets of three. That way, you should be able to get roughly the same result every time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so interesting. I've never put so much thought into making rice balls before.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You all seem to be doing great now!
We should be able to give what you make to our fans now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We were so focused on making these that we forgot to have something to eat. Shall we have a taste of what we've made?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi, please try these!
The one on the right has salmon in it, the middle has bonito and the left is plum flavored.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, okay, I will.
But I can't eat them all, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Um... Haruka, here...!
Could you try some of the rice balls I made?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure, thanks.
Would you like to try mine, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes...! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A... A salmon rice ball made by Haruka herself...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To the farmer who made this rice...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because of your work, I'm able to have a rice ball made personally by Haruka! Thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you. Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope the staff gets as excited about these as Minori is right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I suspect that Minori's the only one who can get so worked up about something like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I kind of want her to enjoy it the most, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe.
The day of
Shibuya Okuyama Building - Basement Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Looks like we're pretty much all set up.
Thank goodness too. We should be able to start on time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. All that's left is for us to do a final rundown and make sure we have something to eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that means...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!
Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for all your hard work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We actually prepared a little surprise for you today. Saito, if you would please.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: A surprise?! For us?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Oh, they're rice balls!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. We made them ourselves.
Please be patient as we hand them out in order.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: M-Made by MMJ?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! The four of us practiced making them quite a lot, so I'm sure they turned out very well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have salmon, bonito, plum and several other flavors, so please choose any you like.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
W-We can really have these?!
Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Now, which one would you like?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Th-Thank you! I'll take a plum one!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Plum it is. Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Oh, there's something written on it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We all wrote a little message on each of them, so we hope you get a chance to read them.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: A homemade rice ball and a handwritten message?!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
Wh-What do I do...?
I might collapse out of sheer joy if I eat this...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: I should preserve this on my shelf forever instead!!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Staff
rows.Line: I know, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Airi
rows.Line: Be sure to eat them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Isn't this the first time just the three of us went somewhere together like this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe so. It usually really is all four of us when we go home or stop by a store.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was really hoping that Airi would join us but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I heard that the Japanese confectionary shop at the mall is selling these special sweets only for the next two days.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! Special sweets...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! How about we head over to try some together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, I'm busy right after this too.
You guys go have fun without me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It must be a very urgent or important matter if Airi's willing to pass up something she loves so much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I have to think so too.
Still, maybe we should buy something for her if it can keep for a few days.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, good idea!
What do you think, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a wonderful idea.
I was just thinking about getting something for my family as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh no!
I forgot to ask Shii what I should get her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Minori, Haruka, you'll have to excuse me for a second!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Sh-Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shiii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And hello to you too, Ichika, Honami.
Are you on your way home from band practice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we all have work after this, so we were just about to go our separate ways.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
Wait, Shiho?! And you two!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You had us worried there for a second running off like that, but I guess it's because you saw Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even so, she ran a fairly long way to catch up to us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, we were pretty far away.
Also, I doubt I could ever sprint like that after practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Only Shizuku has eyes good enough to spot her own sister from such a distance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that I could find Shii wherever she is in this world.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's actually kinda scary...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, why did you have to run over here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were just about to go to the Japanese confectionary shop at the mall.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mom asked me to bring something back and I realized that I should get you something as well, Shii. So what would you like?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You came all this way just to ask me that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes! What would you like?
There's quite a lot for you to choose from.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something simple's fine, like mochi with sweet soybean powder or ohagi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Understood.
Mochi with sweet soybean powder or ohagi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also... Is Momoi not with you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She said she has something to take care of and left a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? Speaking of which, where's Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She also said she's busy and left some time ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It must've been important too considering how anxious she seemed during practice today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Meeting you all here was enough of a surprise, but to think that we're both missing someone from our respective groups...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, a situation just like the one we're in now came up during this suspense novel I've been reading lately...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A suspense novel?
I never would've imagined...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. The protagonists are twin sisters who decided to become private investigators as part of their family's business.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're both very cute and work very hard to solve each case, but do end up fighting from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so interesting! That means you two should try to solve “The Case of Airi and Saki's Important Business”, Shizuku, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm really not cut out to be a private eye.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Saki may've been acting a little strange today, but that doesn't give me license to go digging around her personal business.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, Shii, why don't we try and solve “The Case of What We Should Have for Dinner Tonight”?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a feeling I could solve it right away if we went with Salisbury steaks since they're your favorite♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember trying to guess what was for dinner all the time when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
I would always get it right on curry day too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we used to do that too!
You should've seen the way Shii smiled whenever she got it right. It was so adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More importantly, what happened to stopping by that Japanese confectionary shop? You're making Minori and Kiritani wait the longer you do this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I have to get to work soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, where are my manners...?
I should apologize to you two as well, Ichika, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it was nice to talk like this since it's been a little while since we last did.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I feel the same way.
Also, Shizuku, I'll see you again during our next Cleanup Committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'll see you then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And please get home safe, Shii, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I'll be going now if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: See you at school!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I apologize for making you both wait like this, Minori, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's okay. You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I mean, that story about trying to guess what's for dinner was so cute.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad you enjoyed that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, let's head to that confectionary shop, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
And two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Morning, Shizuku.
Getting another early start?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? Someone's in a good mood.
Lemme guess, something good happened?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's gotten pretty late, but today turned out to be such a fun Valentine's Day.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi's surprise in particular left us all speechless too. I couldn't believe how cute the marzipan dolls of us looked.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'll have to try some of the gifts that Haruka and Minori gave me after dinner...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...?
There's something on my desk.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Are these chocolates...?
There's even a little card...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Let's see... “Happy Valentine's Day”...
But I'm not seeing a name anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, this handwriting...! It has to be...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line:
Shizuku, dinner's ready.
Hurry up and get changed so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shiii!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wah...! Wh-What's gotten into you?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Th-These! They're from you, right, Shii?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, the way “Happy Valentine's Day” has been so carefully written and lined up so nicely just screamed you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even in English, I could tell that it was your handwriting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, you got me. Will you please just try to settle down?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you're still over the moon about Shiho giving you chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Just thinking about it puts a smile on my face...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that's not all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your surprise made Valentine's Day yesterday such a fun occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was nearly driven to tears when I saw marzipan dolls of Miku and everyone else on top of your cake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you like it.
That means it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, I need to thank you as well..

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? Thank me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, you knew about what we were doing, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Is it me or does Saki's house smell really sweet for some reason...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not entirely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I just happened to smell something sweet in the air, so I figured that you were all preparing for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that means you knew.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, pulling one over on Saki's brother and company was no easy task.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were just practicing a dance routine here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki told me all about how she sometimes runs out of energy during band practice and wants to find a way to build her stamina.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Emu also seemed concerned about the way she's been dancing lately during your guys' shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And she wants to try something different since her goal's to put on a sweet and happy show next time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you had me completely convinced that time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The reason I was able to guess what you were doing was actually because I saw the three of you shopping together at the mall.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Time out. Then why were you convinced by our little act that time?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Why?
Because you said that's what was going on, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You just took my word at face value...?
Oh, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, thanks.
You know, for not telling anyone else?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome. Again, thank you for giving us such a fun and wonderful Valentine's Day.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, thank you both for helping me with this. You as well, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, do you think you'll be able to design your outfit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The other girls seem to know exactly how to express themselves, but I just don't know how to do that it seems.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
For the sake of our fans...
For the sake of MORE MORE JUMP!
I want to come up with a good design...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In your mind, what qualifies as a “good design”?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Something that lets everyone from MORE MORE JUMP! really shine on stage...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And ideally, something that can spread hope to all of our fans since they've been a massive source of support for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a slightly better idea of what I want to design after speaking with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what sort of message I want to convey through my outfit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm not really sure how to describe it...
But I can't seem to get a clear idea of what to do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... I mean, this is your first time doing something like this, so it probably isn't gonna be easy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. After giving me such wonderful advice too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, don't say that. I agree with Rin. This is no small task.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The message you're trying to come up with is the most important part of your design, so you should take your time to find the answer you're looking for♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Both of you, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if you took a step back to examine what kind of thoughts and feelings brought about the outfits you're currently using?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The ones we're currently using...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
I've gone ahead and changed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, now I get it! Because their current outfits were born from their feelings!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. I'm wondering if taking a look at those feelings in terms of these outfits can help you get a better image of what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Great idea, KAITO♪
This should make things much easier, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! What stands out to me the most is... The clovers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I can't help but think that these are so cute every time I put this outfit on in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, do you know why these clovers are on your outfit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm not 100% on this...
But I think I've discussed this before with Airi and the others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That time, I remember Airi saying, “It's all about what clovers symbolize.”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What clovers symbolize?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Three-leaf clovers represent “hope” and “promise”, as well as “love”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
“To become idols who can spread hope to others.”
“To promise never again to forget that feeling.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, “To show our idol-loving fans just how much we care about them.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what I think the three leaves on these clovers represent.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. We'll need to work hard to achieve all of the things you just listed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we will.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That means these clovers clearly represent what you're all hoping to achieve as idols.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
It's perfect for you girls.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This must be what happens when one's feelings bring a design to life...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I'm starting to get a much better idea of what to do now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'll still need some time to think.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course. I'm sure you'll think of a wonderful design, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you ever get stuck again, you're always welcome to stop in for another chat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will! Again, thank you all very much for speaking with me today.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have you checked our stream from yesterday? More people than usual have been watching it since it was archived.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I saw! I couldn't believe it either!
They must've really liked our little design competition.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Definitely. I have a feeling it's also because everyone's hoping to see us put on another show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still surprised that we ended up going with my design.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! But your design was so good!
You even made individualized outfits for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. I'm really looking forward to seeing how those outfits turn out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shizuku, you said that you want to get more input from our fans to make your design even more wonderful. Can you handle all that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. My goal is to keep refining what I already have while waiting for them to send us their thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Refine what you already have?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For instance, there are many different kinds of flowery lace that Airi chose for her design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I think it's going to be important to choose the best material, and the best accessories and see if it all fits together through trial and error.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see.
In that case, you should keep picking away at it until you're satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I promise to do everything I can to make this design even more wonderful than it already was.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good! And if you ever need a hand, feel free to let us know!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We have countless different fabrics, lace, buttons, accessories and other materials to choose from, so determining which is best won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I appreciate your concern.
But I should be okay when it comes to those things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know just the person to ask♪
A few days later
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku!
Sorry about the wait.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, Mizuki.
That's okay. Thank you so much for meeting me on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's my pleasure! This is you we're talking about. I'll be there for you in a heartbeat if you ask♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, you want to talk about what materials to use for your stage outfits?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to take a look at as many options as I can and choose the ones that fit our needs best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You mentioned before that you like doing collages, so I have a feeling you know quite a lot about these things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now I understand!
That explains why you asked me to show you a bunch of fabrics and materials.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like you said, there's a lot. So many that I'd really rather have you look at images of some of them to get a better idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But first... Here!
I brought all the flowery lace stuff I could find at home!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They really come in all shapes and sizes. Fine doesn't even begin to describe how detailed some of these patterns are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
I never knew that there were so many different patterns. This is incredible, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
We're just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I brought some colored lace too♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's such a pretty color!
This color... It seems so bright and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But this one has a much crisper color to it. Oh, this other one's gradated.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you're a professional having all this lace in your possession.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Sometimes I really wonder if I could actually open my own store.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, come one, come all!
I've got lots of cute stuff on offer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for meeting with me today, Mizuki. I have a feeling my design's going to improve so much now because of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I'm just glad that I was able to help, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I really love how you guys are turning your design into actual outfits with the help of your fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it'll be the first time many of them are anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we were able to put on an event in real life because of them, so I'm sure our outfits will turn out well if we really work together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Work together, huh?
That's really nice. It's so MMJ!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And as another MMJ fan, I'm really happy that I got a chance to help you like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You are? I'm glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to make sure that our outfits turn into something truly wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to exceed our fans' expectations, including you, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wah! Your smile's blinding!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Feel free to ask for any help if you ever need it! I want to give you all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! Your help means so much!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad Miku and the others liked our outfits so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. It was nice to hear them say they were cute since our thoughts and feelings are essentially a part of them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, also... Would it be alright if I told Mizuki that our outfits are all done?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You want to talk about what materials to use for your stage outfits?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to take a look at as many options as I can and choose the ones that fit our needs best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You mentioned before that you like doing collages, so I have a feeling you know quite a lot about these things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like you said, there's a lot. So many that I'd really rather have you look at images of some of them to get a better idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But first... Here!
I brought all the flowery lace stuff I could find at home!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They really come in all shapes and sizes. Fine doesn't even begin to describe how detailed some of these patterns are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you're a professional having all this lace in your possession.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Sometimes I really wonder if I could actually open my own store.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was able to get a clear idea of our outfits because Mizuki was nice enough to show me all these different materials and such.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'd like to give my thanks while presenting the finished product...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's been a while since I last saw Mizuki, so why don't we three meet up somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll ask Mizuki to see when would be a good time♪
The next day
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, thanks for having me♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This isn't your house, Shizuku.
Also, Mizuki, you don't need to play along.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Sorry, I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, your outfits are all done?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I wanted to show them to you since you were such a tremendous help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! I've been wondering how they turned out, so it's kinda been on my mind for a while now♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, why don't we do our big reveal? Here's a picture of our outfits.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Th-They look amazing!
You guys are gonna look so awesome on stage!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, look at the frills on the hem and how fluffy they made the skirt! It's gonna look so gorgeous as it floats each time you move...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on! And the accessories on the bust! How can anyone sew on decorations with this much detail?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At minimum, these outfits count as being divine!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's the thing! I couldn't believe it when I saw them for the first time either.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll need to thank everyone for putting so much thought into making them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Your own feelings and your fans' love for their favorite idols are a huge part of these, huh, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is so exciting! These are movingly good! I can't wait to see all of you wearing these!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We can't wait to do a show while wearing these too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Does that mean your second real-life show's already in the works?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. We've been thinking about taking this opportunity to sing a brand-new song.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A new song?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hold up. Does that mean...?
A MORE MORE JUMP! original?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. We even got a request from someone saying that they want to write one for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we'll be meeting with them soon to discuss it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! I'm glad things are going so smoothly♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And that's so great...
You already found someone to write it for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... Let's say Kanade knew how to compose music for idols. Would this have been our chance to collaborate with them?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm sure you have high expectations for this person you're meeting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really hope they're nice and able to create music that brings out all of your unique qualities to the forefront! That'd be the best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well.
I'm really looking forward to meeting them.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is so exciting.
I'm really looking forward to seeing Mai's show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
It's supposed to be a modern take on Rapunzel, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm curious to see how they adapted the story!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Same. We can spend some time going through the program once we get to the theater.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They look like they're all having fun today.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm glad Haruka suggested that we take a little break.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? A break?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We haven't taken one in a while because we've been dealing with quite a lot on top of having to work on our streams.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I was thinking that we could take a day off from practice to get in a refresher. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds great!
How about we all go somewhere together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, actually...
Mai's going to be in this show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. No, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Where are you two going?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Weren't you listening just now?
The crepe shop just over that way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought it'd be good to grab a bite since I was just starting to get hungry!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't have too much sugar right now, so I'll pass. How about you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I wouldn't want to ruin my appetite for dinner by having one now, so I'll have to pass as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Looks like it's just you and me, Minori.
We'll be right back if you don't mind waiting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. Have fun, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
They all look so yummy.
Oh, I think I'll get the one with lots of strawberries and whipped cream!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, I think I'll get something more chocolatey. Wanna share a bite once they're ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Seeing them have so much fun like this makes me really glad that we decided to do this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In the end, we need to be in a cheerful mood if we want to spread hope to anyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So what happened with Hasegawa...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There was a time when I felt so “scared” that my body refused to do what it was told.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However... That's also sort of why I don't really know what to say to her right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even after receiving so much support from so many people...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But even after hearing all those kind words and seeing so many people about it, my legs wouldn't stop shaking.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Of course she's worried... She went through what Hasegawa's dealing with right now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Is something the matter?
You've been staring at me for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was just thinking about how you have such wonderful facial features.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Facial features...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I saw this show on TV yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They said that people with eyes like yours, Haruka, are able to see things from an objective standpoint and calmly make decisions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I believe you'll be able to find the best answer for even the most unanswerable questions.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You being so kind and thoughtful has always been a source of hope for me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(She saw right through me...
She knows I'm worried about her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad that what I said seems to have helped you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, what you said about facial features is pretty interesting. That has to do with phrenology and physiognomy, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. To be honest, it was something I saw on TV during dinner...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Apparently, if the corners of your eyes point up, you're more likely to have an increased appetite, and people with plump lips are prone to being anemic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I'm interested in hearing more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wanna try it on me?
What do you see?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well... Your bright eyes and lovely mouth are your best features, Airi, so...
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You don't have practice today, right?
Did you come here to see us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, we did.
There's something we'd like to show all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Something you'd like to show us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how I mentioned Shizuku and I were asked to do some modeling?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember♪
It involved wearing a wedding dress, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does that mean you're here to show us some pictures?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Well done, Miku.
We'd like to show you the pictures we took on our phones to mark the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, yay♪
That means we should tell the others about this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, no... MEIKO and the others might be rehearsing for their show right now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, we can just head over their way later. I have a feeling that a certain someone can't wait to see what we took.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! H-How did you know that I couldn't wait any longer?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You honestly thought we wouldn't be able to tell?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But I understand how Minori feels.
I've been looking forward to this moment as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We also had the fortune of immediately finding Miku and Luka, so why don't we start by looking at them together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but... What you're about to see may take you by surprise.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, why's that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, um... A lot happened and...
Yes, it's a surprise, but it's also a happy one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, let's get this show on the road.
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ohh... Wait, whaaat?!
Sh-Shizuku, is this...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A tuxedo.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. And that led to Shizuku wearing this tuxedo in order to play the groom!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I heard that An played the bride with Kohane as her bridesmaid...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But this suits you so well, Shizuku...! You look so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, Minori.
I appreciate the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But still, a tux...
There's no way I could pull off something like that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm with you there.
But it might look good on Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. You'd probably look really sharp and amazingly cool, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka in a tux...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-W-W-W-Wait, that's... That's...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Too much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: M-Minori?! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I think she overheated.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but I totally get how she feels...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I saw Shizuku walk out in a tux, it felt like a ton of bricks crashing on top of my head!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: O-On top of your head?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really?
And you were okay after that, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course I wasn't okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That must've been quite an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it was. You don't get that kind of visual overload very often...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this tuxedo really does suit you well, Shizuku. You must've looked even more stunning in person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku? What's up...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is, just before I put on that costume, I was a little worried about how I'd actually look in a tuxedo...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I also didn't want to worry An or Kohane, so I readily accepted and went to get changed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And yet, a part of me felt so unsure about doing such a stunning outfit justice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Fortunately, my concerns were unfounded.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, Ms. Kinuya put so much thought into making that tuxedo, so it felt like it was putting on a magical outfit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I felt so much better after actually putting it on.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that I was able to properly play the groom because that tuxedo was willing to lend me its support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so incredible how you're able to bring out the absolute best in the costumes and outfits you wear, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't help but feel envious.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, can you tell us more about your costumes and what happened during the shoot?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear that as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
We still have tons of pics in store for you. Right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Hehe. Which one shall we talk about next?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, this seems like a good place to wrap up our morning practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work...
Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Good morning.
Uh, Shizuku, Airi, are you both free to talk right now by chance?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we can talk. We just wrapped up our morning practice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
Ms. Kawasaki asked me to deliver a present.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ms. Kawasaki...?
Isn't she the person who asked you guys to be models?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, she's a professional photographer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She actually stopped by the cafe An's dad runs to tell us that she received an award for her entry.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And gave us some photos to mark the occasion...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, from during the shoot?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! I wanna see! I wanna see!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're looking at the camera for some of these, but not all of them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you all have such wonderful smiles on your faces...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this was when one of An's heels slipped off as we were moving between scenes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku picked it up and even helped her put it back on. Oh, here it is! This is a photo of that moment!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! She's like a prince...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, my heart raced when I saw that too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? All I did was help her a little since it seemed very difficult to crouch while wearing that dress...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I think trying to copy Len helped as well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm wearing these new shoes because they go with my outfit, but they slip off so easily...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where'd my shoe go...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here it is, Miku.
Mind sticking your foot out for me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, I can put it back on myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (From time to time, we get to see these wonderful displays of chivalry in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'll be sure to tell them about what I did the next time I get a chance to visit.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, did you tell Shiho about us doing some modeling?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. She was there when I told my mom and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but I mostly talked about working with Kohane and the others. I didn't really get a chance to talk about me wearing a tuxedo.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's the case, I'm sure they'll be very surprised when they see these photos.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'll tell them all about what happened after I return home today.
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright...
What do you want to show me so much that you had to call me over?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how I said I'd be doing some work that involves wearing a wedding dress?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The photographer was nice enough to give us some photos of the shoot to mark the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I wanted to show them to you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what this is about...?
Okay, if we're just looking at a few photos...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?! In that case, let's start going through them! There were four of us there and this one shows us all together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?! Shizuku, you wore a tux?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I did! And I was just as surprised since I was under the impression that I'd be wearing a dress.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It actually suits you pretty well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd seen some of your other modeling photos before, but never anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's really nice.
Not only does it suit you, but it's also a fresh perspective.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey! W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe! I couldn't be happier, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
The photos are gonna get all crumpled!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It'll be fine♪ I'm being careful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You say that, but...
If you're gonna be this clingy, I'm heading back to my room.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
B-But!
There are still so many photos that I want to look at with you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then promise not to literally be all over me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise.
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, good work!
I unfortunately need to get going now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay. Thank you for today, Airi.
We'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi left right after practice again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Probably so she can keep planning for our training camp.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. She seems to be really enjoying it too, so I'm looking forward to it very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, Haruka, here's a towel.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
And I'm definitely with you there. I'm excited to see what kind of training camp Airi comes up with for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, what do you think it's gonna be like? Whenever I hear training camp, I usually imagine the beach or...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, she mentioned how she asked MEIKO for some advice regarding training activities.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-She asked MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Didn't Miku and the others say that their training was super duper hard...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean we're gonna have to do a lap around Shibuya while only doing squat hops...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I doubt she'll make us do anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haha. Y-Yeah!
As tough as she can be sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On top of squat hops not actually being a very good workout, it's also easy to injure yourself, so I don't see her choosing that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have to think that she'll have clear objectives in mind for each activity. For example, long-distance running for building stamina or sprinting up a hill to strengthen your lower body.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-Long distance running... Sprinting up a hill... Th-That sounds like the kind of stuff professional athletes do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, aren't we going to be streaming as we train?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If so, I have to think that she's going to have us do activities that are also fun and appealing to our viewers, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Airi always makes the enjoyment of our viewers a priority.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, Shizuku, what do you think she's gonna have us do?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hmm... I think...
Oh, a high-endurance dance-off could be fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Like the one they did on The Wide World of Laughs?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A high-endurance dance-off...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi was a regular on that show when she was still in QT, right? They had her participate in a dance-off?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You could even say that it was the first step she took towards becoming Airi the legendary variety idol!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She put on such a cool performance that time too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really?
What did they have her do exactly?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, they had forty newbie idols split into two teams, red and white, and they had to keep dancing until the members of one side were all eliminated...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You had to dance like you meant it, and you were eliminated if you made a mistake or didn't quite execute a move properly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That sounds like an event in and of itself... So, what happened during the show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Most of the idols made it through the first forty minutes, but Airi's teammates on the red team started getting eliminated one by one after an hour had passed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not long after that, Airi was the only idol from the red team that remained.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While the white team still had eleven.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right! I was so sure that the red team was done for...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But that was Airi's moment!
She danced for two and a half hours straight until everyone on the white team was eliminated!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Two and a half hours...? The others must've put up a good fight, but Airi really is something else.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was at that station for some other business and got to see her for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You saw her legendary performance live?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She really did dance like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The others seemingly tried doing everything they could, like dancing with a little less power, to save their energy, but they all looked like they were in so much pain...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi had this beautiful smile on her face while she danced. It was as if she was performing live on stage right then and there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I unfortunately had to leave before the end to go to my next appointment, but based on how dazzling she was, I knew the others didn't stand a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I was so happy when I actually saw it happen later on TV. I couldn't contain myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
That's such a nice story. I wish I could've seen that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, we really went on a tangent there. We were discussing what we'll be doing during our training camp, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, but that's fine. I really enjoyed this story.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. We should ask Airi sometime about what things were like that time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a wonderful idea!
I'd love to hear what she has to say.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's ask her during practice next time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka, Airi, how did that part look just now...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You both were in much better sync that time, but you're still getting stuck here and there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Minori, I think you fell a little behind going into that part and Shizuku ended up stumbling trying to match up with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I really need to apologize to you, Shizuku. I promise to figure out how to transition smoother into the part where we both dance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand how difficult that part is since it also took me quite a while to figure out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I may be able to help by giving you some pointers when it comes to timing everything and such, so let's just keep trying together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that should be a good place to end our break.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, wait! Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After you left yesterday, we...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You talked about the high-endurance dance-off? Wow, talk about a blast from the past.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! And we were hoping that you could tell us more about what happened that time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Would that be alright, Airi?
You don't have to if you're not comfortable with it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
I still remember everything clearly since it turned into such a huge event and a really hot topic later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But what exactly were you hoping to hear?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think we all would love to hear what you were feeling as you danced!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Shizuku even said, “It was as if she was performing live on stage right then and there,” so I'm also really curious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold on, Shizuku...
Were you in the studio that time?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I was there for something else and decided to get a peek before my next appointment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously?! This is news to me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Unlike when we were still in training, we didn't get to see each other much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what was going through your mind as you danced?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
That time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We split into two teams, red and white... But to be honest, I wasn't feeling all that competitive initially.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I actually thought that I'd be able to motivate myself and stay in the game longer by imagining that my fans were right there watching me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Imagining that your fans were right there?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, when it aired, thousands and thousands of people were watching.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, was it really that fun watching idols dance until they became totally exhausted?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really enjoyed it since the way you kept trying gave me so much encouragement... But your point's also valid. Smiling is sorta better than panting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I was able to dance like I meant it because I kept telling myself that I was performing live on stage that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means Shizuku was spot on yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, aren't we going to be streaming as we train?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If so, I have to think that she's going to have us do activities that are also fun and appealing to our viewers, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I was.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As a result, I had fun and got to dance until the end. Also, I was so focused on the music that I sorta just blocked out everything that was going on around me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone was kinda going nuts towards the end too, so I knew I had a good shot at winning as long as I hung in there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, after they announced that I'd won, I kept dancing as a sort of victory lap to show my appreciation for everybody watching!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I even remember you winking and doing your Momoi pose after you'd finished dancing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Were you there until the end, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I saw that part on TV.
I actually started tearing up a little after you gave me that wink.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I remember thinking, “This Airi Momoi girl's such an amazingly cool idol!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, quit exaggerating, you two...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, we aren't!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since around that time, Airi, you've been the incredibly cool and spectacular idol that I've been looking up to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-Again, you're exaggerating.
Also, flattery won't get you anywhere with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't mind as long as you understand how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Q-Quit saying stuff like that.
You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I kind of feel like we should do a dance-off now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, great idea!
We can even invite Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And if I end up facing you, Airi, I won't let you win so easily.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? Those are some big words you're throwing around there. In the face of the champ no less.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, as the champion...
Challenge accepted!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, we've done our jobs as the opening act, so let's go see what else is going on at Shibuya Festa!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, there were many stalls set up too. We could spend quite a bit of time just seeing what they have to offer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Do you think there's a caramel apple stall? They look really cute and I've been meaning to try one!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
Oh, I really wanna try some cotton candy♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, we'll buy some for all of you and bring everything over to SEKAI later.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, you will?! Thank you so much!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's head over to Main Street!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's fine and all, but we probably shouldn't walk around without disguising ourselves. Let's take some time to do that before we head out...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
An idol can cause a big commotion if they're not careful and walk around normally...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You get that you're that idol, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's prepare ourselves some disguises.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa... There's way more people here than usual. Getting where we want's gonna be a challenge.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Be sure to stick together.
Especially you, Shizuku. Try not to lose sight of us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: R-Right, I'll be careful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, we may be able to talk to Miku and the others without anyone else noticing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are there any stalls that you'd like to see? You have a lot of options to choose from it seems...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There's one for caramel apples.
Oh, there's even a stand that has “Italian Spaghetti Sticks”. That sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, that does sound interesting.
What do you think they're like...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's a bit hard to tell just based on that name...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
There's also your standard festival fare.
Yakisoba, takoyaki, buttery potatoes... Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What's up, Shizuku?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I just noticed that there's a stall that's selling rice cracker sandwiches. I remember getting some with Shii when we were little. She always spun the wheel for me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Why does a rice cracker stall need a wheel like that?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These stalls usually have a wheel for customers to spin that decides how many rice crackers they get.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, that sounds fun! And very festive!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Would you mind showing us?
I'd like to see how many you all get.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
We can split what we get too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. This should be fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Good luck, girls!
We'll be watching from inside your pocket!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Leading off for us will be... Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'm gonna go for first prize! One hundred rice crackers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here we... GOOOO!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, how'd it go?!>

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
You win fifty!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's incredible, Minori!
Fifty means you got second prize!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
Hehe. I did it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold up. What are you getting second prize right off the bat for?! If this were a variety show, they'd have to edit all this out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Fortunately, we're not shooting for one. So, Minori, congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And I'll go next.
I hope I get at least thirty.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Where'd it land...?!

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line:
Wow!
Congratulations, young lady! You also win fifty!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
It must be your lucky day, you two.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, it might be set up in a way that makes it easy for everyone to win a lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, Airi, you're next...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This means I have to get fifty... Or even a hundred...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Or would it be better for me to aim low and get ten or so...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi, you still sound like you're shooting a scene for a variety show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She just always wants the best possible outcome for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm ready.
Let's see what happens. Here we...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: GOOOO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where did it stop...?!

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line: Hey, not bad. That's thirty for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, how am I supposed to react to that number?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I thought it was a nice result.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You think so?
Well, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm way too obsessed with getting the perfect shot! I feel like a total workaholic!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Last but not least, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I hope I win a lot...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, it's spinning!
And it's our very last turn!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I think it's about to stop...
A hundred may be a bit difficult...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So close!
You almost had it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wah!
It's a really strong gust!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, where'd that come from... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did that gust just move the wheel? You win a hundred...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line:
Congratulations, miss!
That's one hundred for you! It looks like Lady Luck is on your side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How do you always manage to do this, Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay! We got so many!
50+50+30+100 makes... 230!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The four of us just spun the wheel for fun... But this might be a lot even for ten people...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I honestly didn't expect us to win so many...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Still, I'm looking forward to having them with all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Same!
This means we get to have a rice cracker party in SEKAI tonight!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, we do.
We'll bring them over shortly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We even received a large assortment of fillings as a bonus. These should make our sandwiches all the more fun and delicious.

rows.Line:
(Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku

It's been such a wonderful day.)

Hi, Shizuku!
