rows.Line: Really?! Thank you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, personal space...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Bye, Shiho.
See you tomorrow at school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And after that, I ended up winning a hundred rice crackers.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how you won fifty for the two of us during that one festival and we shared them? What happened today reminded me of that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You still remember that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad to hear that you were all able to enjoy Shibuya Festa after going on stage as the opening act...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we were able to see quite a lot because Airi suggested that we disguise ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so moved by your band's performance today, Shii! You all played very well, and Ichika sang so beautifully...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I wanted to tell the others too...
I'd completely forgotten when we were all together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind telling them tomorrow, Shii? You really did put on a wonderful performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll let them know...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I got to see a part of your show too, Shizuku. You were also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori? Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina, hello!
We've been running into each other quite a lot lately.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thank you for earlier.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you going around Shibuya Festa together just now? I'd heard some stories before, but you two really do seem close.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, actually, I happened to run into Shii just a second ago. We decided to head home together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By the way, Hinomori, you put on a great performance.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, this may be just me, but it felt like we made eye contact part way through...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I managed to find you that time. It was my little way of thanking you for taking the time to watch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that it worked too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'll go on ahead, Shizuku.
I have a feeling that you want to stay and talk to Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What?!
W-Wait, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I do want to talk to Asahina, but I also want us to go home together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hey, how many times do I have to tell you?! Personal space!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Haha. You two really are close.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: G-Great, now she's laughing at us...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I've heard quite a lot about you.
For example, how you bow to news anchors whenever they do their greeting...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And how you bound down the stairs when you know that you're going to have Salisbury steak for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Isn't she just the cutest?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, why am I being put in the spotlight? What happened to talking about how well your show went?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, we shouldn't take up too much of Asahina's time. If we're gonna head home together, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
Asahina, let's chat more about this again at school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sure.
I'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me too!
I'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Asahina noticed how close we are, Shii. I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's great and all...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But can you stop telling her literally everything about me? How do you expect me to talk to her next time?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, why not?
I'm just telling her the truth...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's the problem...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Nevermind...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I can't wait to chat again with Asahina at school.
One month before the solo show
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone, I'm looking forward to... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What are all these cardboard boxes doing here?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Perfect timing!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Coming♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Were you all about to open these boxes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
We got here a little early, so we decided to take a look.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think's inside, Shizuku? Can you guess?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Inside? Um...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll give you a hint. They're things that our fans will need to really enjoy our show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Things they'll need? To enjoy our show...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
It's our merchandise!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We have a winner♪
Nicely done, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, you three, that's enough celebrating. Help me out with these, will you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
This box is filled with towels!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This one has the T-shirts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've got glow sticks over here!
Look! They even say “MORE MORE JUMP!” on them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course they do.
They were made specifically for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I understand how she feels.
After all, these are some of the first pieces of merchandise that were made with her in mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I was still in Cheerful * Days, I remember my manager always showing us the samples for merchandise whenever they arrived.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, did you all inspect the merch yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, they really just showed us since we'd usually design some of them ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that stopped after a while when we started offering a wide array of merchandise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, merchandise can sort of grow out of control pretty fast. I remember looking over some featured items for certain events, but not much outside of that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, which is why I really enjoy the fact that we get to look over our own merchandise like this. Thankful too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's inspect everything thoroughly to make sure our fans only get quality products!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, try turning on that glow stick for me. We need to check how it looks when its lights are on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll start unfolding these T-shirts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do the same for these towels.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the fabric they used to make these towels is so soft. They feel nicer than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lemme see...
Hey, they do feel nice!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad we did our homework for these. You can end up with stuff that feels really hard or frays easily if you're not careful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. And these should hold together fine when you twirl them around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they should be able to handle that and a spin in the washing machine just fine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That means the wristbands we ordered should feel just as nice since we asked for the same fabric.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, can you take a look at this T-shirt for me? How does it look?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! It looks great on you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
However, that's not what I'm asking...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, right! We're supposed to be inspecting everything! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You'll want to see if the printing looks okay and if our group name and individual names have been spelled correctly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Again, this really takes me back...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I saw my name on merchandise like this for the first time, I remember...)
Cheerful * Days Theater

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Here you are, Shizuku.
This looks like your merch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Wow, this towel... It's such a pretty color.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Cheerful * Days... SHIZUKU HINOMORI...
My name... It's really written right on here...)

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Hehe. You look so happy, Shizuku.
Just make sure your name's spelled right, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If my name's spelled right?

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: Yeah, especially when a person's name includes something like a “zu”, “dzu” or “tzu” sound.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: You'd think it wouldn't happen, but it actually does a lot...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see. I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: “Fu” gets misspelled too sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: The managers and others are all probably going to inspect everything... But it's still good to check just in case.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right...
Thank you very much. I'll keep a close eye out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm? Shizuku?
Is it just me or do you seem really happy right now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I noticed that too. Do those towels really feel that nice?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's part of why.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But also because these reminded me of when I got to take a look at my own merchandise for the very first time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since these will be in the hands of our valued fans soon, we should take a close look at them and see what they're like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally agree!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, you just want to browse through all our merch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You're not wrong...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is when you're supposed to say I am there!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In just about a month, all of this merchandise is going to be in the hands of our fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I hope they like what we have to offer.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Our show is one thing, but I really want them to enjoy these as well.)
Show Venue - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does everybody have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we're all set.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The staff's got theirs too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then...
Let's begin the after party for our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hand on. Why don't we have Minori lead for us since it was her big moment today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait, me?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree! Especially since you gave us such a lovely speech during the show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind taking the lead here, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like it if you did as well.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Pleeease!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wah! All of you?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
I'll do it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Ahem.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Today marks an auspicious occasion...
Uhh... I could not be more pleased to see that our solo show went so well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is starting to sound like one of those matchmaking interviews...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. She's pleased.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's very cute and very Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... We couldn't have done this without any of you! We were able to give the fans an incredible show because of all your help!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Quit stammering!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah! S-Sorry, I can't help it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Anyway, thank you very much for all your hard work! And so, here's to a successful show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... How was it? Did I do okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it was a cute speech.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about heckling you, but I did manage to get a few good laughs...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice speech, Minori.
So, cheers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'd like to thank the staff again for all your hard work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We really appreciate it.
So, please enjoy these sandwiches.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: What...?! Th-Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Uhh... I'm so glad that I got to help out in the first MMJ solo show! It was really fun! I promise to keep supporting all of you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, thank you for your kind words! We promise to do our best to keep bringing you fun shows like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much for helping us put on this event as well, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was thanks to your planning and instruction that the staff were able to carry out what they needed to do. We couldn't have done it without you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Sh-Shizuku...?!
I-I'm not worthy! I mean... I'm so honored!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: P-Please, allow me to thank you all as well...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank us?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes! You probably remember how we ran into a bit of trouble during the fan event the other day because of my lack of foresight when it came to setup and carrying things...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Fortunately, all of that went smoothly this time.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I really appreciate how all of you took the time to discuss all of that with us beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This experience has meant quite a lot to me. So, thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to be so formal. Also, I didn't come up with everything that I told you just now. We had the help of some of our idol seniors.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Would you be willing to thank them for me as well...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. If it's okay with you that is. Right, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You can count on us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I know the show just ended... But since we're on the subject, was there anything in particular that gave you trouble this time around?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh... I'd probably say that it would've been nice to have a few more on board as staff... Can you guys think of anything else besides that?

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Oh, towards the beginning, we had a little trouble in terms of communication when it came to assigning roles.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I thought this one person was also selling merch with me, and I ended up telling them about how we're running low on some stuff without realizing that they were a guide... That seemed to confuse them a lot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
It probably didn't help that all the staff were all wearing the same T-shirts.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Come to think of it, a lot of people were asking people who weren't guides for directions.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that's only natural. I mean, from their point of view, we're all the same staff...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Right... Numbers and assignments... We'll have to keep those points in mind for the future.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Oh, about our roles... What if we had armbands that say what we've been assigned to do...?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
We sold wristbands today too.
What if they were color-coded?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We can use Airi's color for people selling merch! I bet they'd feel better knowing you're on their side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, that's your reasoning?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, how about either Minori or Haruka's color for the guides? I'm not sure how I'd feel about Team Shizuku giving others directions...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-It's true that I don't have the best sense of direction, but my color's done nothing wrong...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're willing to admit the first part of that...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They're all smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (On top of that, they're providing us with suggestions regarding how to make our next one better.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's like we get to walk forward hand-in-hand with all those who support us...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That must be what MORE MORE JUMP! is truly about.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure you're all very hungry too, MORE MORE JUMP! Please, have some of these sandwiches with us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
Um, can you all see us okay?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I can see you!>
<Hi! I'm so glad I was able to be here from the start of the stream!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Looks like we're all set!
So, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We're calling today's stream the...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Post Solo Show Stream♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I believe this goes without saying, but we're gonna talk all about our solo show and would also like to hear from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It was the best show ever!>
<I was in tears from the start.>
<I couldn't go! Please do another show!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that.
Thank you all for your comments!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My heart races every time I think about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had done many shows with my old agency, but this one felt incredibly special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It felt like a dream, but it was real.
It was our show. We made it happen.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, exactly! Also, getting to show everybody our new outfits made me very happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we wanted you all to see us wearing them as soon as we could!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your outfits were so cute!>
<You were all dazzling! I liked the initial designs, but seeing you wearing them on stage was something else!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We need to thank Shizuku for designing them, and the fans who actually put them together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I think my outfit allowed me to sing and dance better than I normally do.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It felt like you cast a spell on all of us!>
<I know, right? Those outfits were amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your new song was also awesome!>
<I'm so jealous. If only I could get a ticket...>
<Please do a tour for all of us who live in other parts of the country!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A tour, huh...?
How amazing would that be?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Some of our fans even wrote letters asking us to do just that! And to perform at the Dome!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<MMJ's ready for bigger and better venues!>
<Please do shows at the Butokan and the Dome!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You all...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once we've become famous enough to go on tour, I want us to do a show at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to spread hope to everyone in Japan... Just like how ASRUN did with me when I saw them for the first time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's hard for me to say how high our ceiling is since we don't belong to an agency...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But at the very least, our fans want to see us go on tour and perform at the Dome.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
Your support means absolutely everything to us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And then there's Minori...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi, Haruka and I have a habit of grounding ourselves in reality, but Minori doesn't.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (To her, dreams aren't something you see. Dreams are things that you make come true.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku...?
Why are you staring at Minori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
D-Don't tell me...
Is there something on my face?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm sorry.
You had such a wonderful expression on your face just now. It was very captivating.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?! I captivated you, Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Shizuku, your side profile's also really pretty!>
<Good for you, Minori. Let her stare until she bores holes in you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wait, I don't want that to happen!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, there's a lot that we want to discuss. Why don't we start with the venue for our solo show?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, since booking it sort of involves its own story.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. And we had quite a few discussions with everyone about how we were going to decorate it.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, I wanna hear more!>
<Tell us how you decided to decorate everything!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. As long as we have the time, we're gonna keep talking about everything that happened that day!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, we hope you'll stick around and enjoy.
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, the bath's ready for you anytime.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, no... Not really.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, that can't be!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa! H-Hey, personal space...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You looked like you wanted to say something just now, Shii. It's okay. You can tell me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
O-Okay, I get it!
Just gimme some breathing room first...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's not like anything's wrong...
But you seem a lot more cheerful compared to yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...? I do?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I hadn't thought that, I wouldn't have done a double take. Anyway, you seem to have found a solution to whatever was bothering you, so we don't have to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we do!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, personal space...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's very, very, very important to me that you noticed, Shii!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I already told Mom and Dad, so you should also know, Shii. The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're going to be on TV...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. After discussing it with Haruka, Minori and Airi, we decided to accept their offer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's great.
It'll be a great chance for your group to really get your name out there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's sort of why we decided to accept.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll do just fine, but we promise to not cause any trouble for you and our family.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry about us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I appreciate the thought, but you shouldn't have to think about what-ifs since I'm fairly certain that you guys already have a lot on your plate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, Shizuku, how do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: H-How do I feel?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About how you're gonna appear to others, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii. I really appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually... People who haven't been watching our streams may be in for a bit of a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But my goal is to just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We went through quite a lot in the beginning, but I want everybody to learn more about Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess there's nothing to worry about since Momoi, Kiritani and Minori will be there with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's so sweet of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While we're at it, Shii, why don't we take a bath together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No way. Also, I already took one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, you'll need to keep the fact that we'll be appearing on TV a secret. We only just sent our acceptance reply.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know.
Promise to tell me once you know when it's supposed to air.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you'll watch it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
If I have time.
Oh, Saki's probably gonna want to watch it no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can see that.
Then, I'll let you know when we have an air date.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm going to my room.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you for letting me know that the bath is ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii and the others are all going to watch. That means we need to make the most of our iHaz appearance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello everyone! Let's give this everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm looking forward to this♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're looking cheerful today, Shizuku. What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, you noticed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My little sister Shii and her friends are throwing me a birthday party tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, wow!
Hehe, well that is quite something to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait... Isn't your birthday still a way off, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since she'll be busy streaming on her actual birthday, they moved it to the holiday that comes just before the day itself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. That makes it easier to fit into everyone's schedules, too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see! So it's not on the day of, but the tradeoff means a bigger and better party♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup, we're all going, not to mention Shiho—her younger sister—and even her friends. We've also invited a few other people!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, sounds like nobody wants to miss your big day. Isn't that great, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm already feeling excited!
But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's just one thought I can't shake.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While I'm grateful to Shii for making my birthday so memorable, I'm honestly quite surprised that she's doing this for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh yeah... Shiho is more of the lone wolf type, and being at the center of a bustling party isn't exactly her thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly, but when I asked her why, she just replied with a flimsy “I just felt like it”.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still... I wouldn't think throwing a party is stretching too far from her boundaries, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose. Plus, her closest friends are helping out, and apparently they're having fun doing so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then I don't see any problem. It is Shiho we're talking about. She could just be too shy to talk about it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I guess when it comes to family, you don't need a reason to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's right, Shizuku!
Just go enjoy yourself!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And we'll be there to celebrate with you on your birthday itself♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, thank you everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay then, shall we get started with today's practice session?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
The day of the party
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're gathered here today for Shizuku's birthday party!
Let part one commence!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hurray♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki, no need to be so loud. Also, what's with this “part one” business?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Part one” means “part one”. We're all booked up for the afternoon, remember? We can't make it to the party her sister arranged.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That means we've only got until noon to give her a full day's worth of fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki.
You too, Ena. I'm so happy you could make it despite having art class!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now, I couldn't miss a friend's birthday, could I?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: About that, Shizuku. Are you sure you're okay with coming to the arcade?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've been shopping so much recently, so I understand wanting a change of pace...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My reason isn't particularly exciting. I was thinking about doing something a little different with everyone, and then I spotted a sign for the arcade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? That's it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I approve. Sometimes, you gotta listen to your impulses♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, enough chit-chat! From retro gems to the latest stuff, this place is a gold mine!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
Shizuku, does anything here catch your eye?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Let's see...
How about trying out Mole War?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know that one! It's like your typical whack-a-mole, but it's for two players!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Hmm... Looks like Player One controls the moles, while Player Two tries to smush them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh-huh! Well, I guess Player Two gets the traditional thwacking experience, but they do get the challenge of predicting where they'll pop up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As the “mole mastermind”, Player One gets a control panel of numbered buttons to choose where the moles pop out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The key to victory is to be unpredictable to give your opponent a real hard time♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: One more thing! If you don't press any buttons for three seconds, the moles will start popping out themselves. You've been warned!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That means the whacker wins if they hit more moles, and the mole controller wins if dodge more hits.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like fun. Shizuku, why don't you give it a go?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay! Hm, I think I'd like to be the whacker first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Leave the mole control to me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
Will you be able to keep up with all my mole madness, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, got you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh?! Wha—
How did you keep seeing them coming?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Try this on for size!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hi there! Hmph!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't tell me you actually anticipated that one! Shizuku, are you reading my mind or something?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey Mizuki, weren't you the one who mentioned the importance of a good strategy?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't talk to me!
Take this...and that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, thwack!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: M-Man, I lost!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, those moles make the most adorable squeak when they stick their little heads out. That was so much fun. Thank you, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ahaha...
Clearly my mole mastermind plan to let Shizuku have fun did the trick!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Big talk from someone whose every move just got predicted.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi, we should have a go too. Do you want to be the whacker or the moles?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm, I think I'll be the mole controller. I'm not holding back, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh huh.
I wouldn't expect anything less. I'll follow in Shizuku's footsteps and crush you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good luck, both of you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The coins are in...
That means it's game on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Got you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hyah! Take that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Time to switch to the opposite side...now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Opposite side?! That's the same hole!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Over here! No, over there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Grgh! You're not...getting...away!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oooh, this is getting intense!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, they're both so in sync with each other, like they're pounding rice to make mochi.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh yeah, I can see what you mean!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahhh... That was fun! Did our birthday girl have fun?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I had such a great time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I got to try out so many games I'd never played before, and we even made Print Stickers!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh no! I really need to get going or I'll miss my art class!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh oh, it's almost time for my shift, too. Shizuku, I'll send you a birthday message later!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I hope you have fun at the party with your sister and her friends!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will! Thank you both so much for today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I guess it's about time we head to yours, Shizuku. They should be done with the party prep, which means they're just waiting for the birthday girl to arrive!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm home...
Wow!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Incredible! Just look at all those adorable little birdies decorating the room! You guys did all this just for me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, yeah, it is a birthday party. I thought we ought to decorate it like one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Those were all your sister's idea. It seems Tenma and the others looked everywhere to help find them, too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kiritani, please...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sh-Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, calm down. The party hasn't even started yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, it's time!
Shiho♪ Would you do the honors and give a speech?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uhm... I'd like to start by thanking everyone for choosing to spend your day off here with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, you're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And...
Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeees?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Um...
Happy birthday...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's raise a toast.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, cheers!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone, I've cut up the cake!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, you get first pick. Ah, how about that one? It looks a little bigger than the rest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, okay. I guess I'll take it then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shizuku! We bought a bunch of snacks we think you'd really like. There's one of each!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Since An's helping out at Weekend Garage, she told me to give you these snacks in her stead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really? I can't wait to try them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that we've all had our fill, it's time to get serious with a game of President!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Saki
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since there are so many of us, I brought two decks of cards. Don't worry about the backs being different!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, since that makes it much easier to make pairs, let's say no more than four cards at once!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hope you're all familiar with the rules of President. I'll be explaining some more house rules while I deal!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Kohane
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So many players... I'm excited to see how this turns out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! I've got three queens. Can anyone else top that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What! N-No way. I can't believe you have three of a kind of such a high card!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe... Looks like I'm in the lead—)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, may I?
There. Three twos!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wha?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's my turn again!
Okay! Three aces.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait! This can't be real!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Urgh...
If only I had won the first round! Here. Take my two strongest, why don't you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi.
Wow, I have a lot of Kings. Would you like one?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Urgh... Y-Yes, but the rules say you gotta give me your two weakest cards.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka! Please, accept this card of mine. It's the strongest one I have!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh, look at them go! I wanna be the President or Vice-President next!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, you came third to last. You're closer to becoming the beggar.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As if that would happen. I got a pretty good hand this time, so I'm gonna do my best to ace this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Ahhh!
Honami, wait!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry Ichika! The rules say a set of eights ends the trick!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehehe. Looks like it's just the three of us. So which one of you will take my place as beggar!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What... What do I do?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kohane, Hoshino, there's no need to play nice out of respect for her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi, Kohane, Ichika!
I'm rooting for you all!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I made us some tea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow... This tea Honami gave me has such a lovely fragrance!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It really does.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was so lively here a while ago, and now it's so quiet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, it's as quiet as it usually is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I guess so. Today isn't just any ordinary day, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, thank you so much for organizing a birthday party for me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's been so long since I got into a heated game of cards with friends like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't mention it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was pretty fun. And not just the party, but the organizing too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. You still haven't told me why you decided to do this for me, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I told you. I just felt like it.
Well, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We're family, right?
Sometimes a little effort is worth it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, thanks for everything, sis.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Heh, no thank you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hinomori. I heard that your little sister and her friends threw a party for you. Hehe, what a thoughtful sister you have. Hehe, I'm a little jealous.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shizuku, I know I've already said this, but happy birthday! I didn't expect an arcade to be your choice of venue, but it was so fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too, me too♪ To think we even got to make Print Stickers together! I'll treasure them for the rest of my life. I really want to hang out again, so hit me up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shizuku, best wishes for your birthday! Although it was supposed to be all about you, I had so much fun myself. So, thank you for a wonderful day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds like Kohane enjoyed herself enough to compensate for me not making it! Shizuku, I hope you had a fantastic day. Let's celebrate together properly sometime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hinomori, it was your birthday, right? I hope you had a good one. Thanks for always being there for my sister. May this next year bring you two closer together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wishing you a joyous birthday, Shizuku! If only my show didn't clash with your party...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here's to you, from a fellow older sibling. May we endeavor to continue watching over our younger sisters!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shizuku, we haven't hung out like this in such a looong time. I had a blast! Let's play cards again sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope you had a wonderful birthday, Shizuku. Shiho told me you liked the tea. If I get some more, I'll be sure to share it with you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad we got the chance to spend time together after so long. Also, I'm not sure if this'll put you at ease or not, but we promise to look out for Shiho. The four of us will be working hard together!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Leave it to us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, it's just like they said. Likewise, I hope you continue to embrace yourself on your idol journey. I'll also be trying my hardest to achieve my dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, I was so shocked when Shiho asked me to help her plan your party.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. Since your sister was incredibly invested in the idea, and we also wanted to celebrate, it was a no-brainer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Shizuku, your little sis is quite something. That is precisely why you should give her enough space to breathe!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha, here's to spending another year of your life as a member of MORE MORE JUMP! and spreading hope to our fans!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only did Shii and her friends throw me a party, but I got to celebrate on my actual birthday too! I'm so happy I could spend time with so many people.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My family, my friends, my fans... It's thanks to all of you that I feel surrounded by warmth.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your love and support are what keeps me going as a member of MORE MORE JUMP! That is why I, Shizuku Hinomori, will endeavor to continue spreading hope!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So please, keep watching me!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Mornings are getting so cold now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Not only that, it snowed last night.
There may be some snow still left on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're supposed to practice dancing today, but I'm not sure we'll be able to this morning... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's the snow rabbit I made yesterday!
Hehe. You're still here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I often used to make snow rabbits when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Snow rabbits?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Because Shii always really liked it whenever I did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this might be just enough snow... All you have to do is round some up into a ball and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For the eyes...we can use these bamboo berries, and some leaves for the ears. And there you are. A snow rabbit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's very cute...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope you'll stay with us for a little bit longer, Mr. Snow Rabbit.
After school

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness we were able to practice today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we really need to thank Miku and the others later for letting us use one of the stages in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I wasn't expecting to see so much snow still left on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I wonder if Mr. Snow Rabbit already melted away... It should be somewhere around...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness! It's still... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you find something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, snow rabbits!
Five of them too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The one in the middle's bigger than the others around it... Hehe. What if they're a family?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Who do you think made these?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I made the big one that the babies are surrounding.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Then, who made the little ones?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Who? I'm not sure. Mine was the only one here when I checked this morning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What if others discovered your rabbit and decided to make some friends for it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know what they say. Loneliness can be fatal for a rabbit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's apparently not actually true...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Rabbits do tend to share nests, but they apparently prefer to sleep and forage for food by themselves!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds like being on the Animal Caretaker Committee has turned you into an expert on rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm still no expert...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, you may be right that somebody decided to make these baby rabbits so that mine wouldn't feel lonely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, the one on the left here seems kinda lonely...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The left...? Oh, there is a little bit of space between it and the others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I had a feeling...
I think I'll make a friend for it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I wanna make one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, can you show us how you made yours look so cute?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to learn as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. First, you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Carefully place it... Don't let it fall apart... Airi, how does mine look?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Perfect!
It nicely filled up that empty spot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Eight in total now. That's quite a big family.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and thank you all for helping make it such a lively scene.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Hehe. I bet the people who made these baby rabbits won't expect to see how much this family's grown.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I sure hope they like what we've done.)
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Minori and Haruka said that they'll start heading over to the cafeteria in a little bit, so let's go over and claim some seats.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm very much looking forward to having lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since we didn't have practice this morning, I got to walk to school with Shii today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And the snow rabbits were still there, so I decided to show her. However, she already seemed to know about them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, she saw them on her way home?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but I learned something else while talking to her that was even more surprising.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As it turns out, Shii and her friends made those other snow rabbits!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! You mean those baby rabbits that we saw surrounding yours, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! She was also surprised when she found out that we made those other ones.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haha! Yeah, I bet.
I would've loved to see her reaction.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's Asahina.
Why don't you go say hi to her?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll wait right here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi!
Then, I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello, Hinomori.
Can I help you? Is there something you need?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I just wanted to thank you again for what you did the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The other day...? Oh, do you mean my umbrella?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you for sharing it with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how I broke mine after I slipped and fell on top of it? You really saved me that time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It was nothing, really.
More importantly, are you okay? Didn't it hurt when you fell?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm okay. Hehe. It's nothing to be proud of, but it may be because I'm used to falling while practicing dance routines.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Have you had a chance to see the snow rabbit again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Do you mean the one you made?
I did. I was wondering if it was still there on my way to school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I was surprised to see that there were more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too!
It was so nice to see how it turned into a big family.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't think about it when I made mine, but it must've felt so lonely having to sit there all by itself...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I sort of wish that they'd never melt away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The expression she just made. It's like the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate
rows.Line:
Mafuyu! Let's start eating!
I'm starving!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, be right there!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: See you later, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
See you again during archery club.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I wonder if I helped her in the end.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If you do wish to help her, it might be good to actually say that.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's no way for idols to know exactly what their fans are feeling or going through, but you can tell them that they have your support...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That sort of kindness can do wonders for a person in need.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, if there is something bothering you, I'd like for you to talk to me about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You saved me once before, Asahina.
Now it's my turn to help you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't know what I can do right now, but my feelings haven't changed...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So... Maybe someday...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I should return to Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi!
Thank you for waiting!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The script says that we're going to introduce ourselves and give a brief overview of what happened during our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, we'll mention how our fans helped make our stage outfits...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope I'll be okay for that part...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I was still in Cheerful * Days, all I did was say what the scripts I was given told me to...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I need to use my own words to tell the viewers what happened during this shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In particular, those who haven't seen our streams may still see me as the “perfect” Shizuku Hinomori from Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope I have time to touch on that a little when I introduce myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, we've made our decision, so nothing will come of worrying like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I need to do what I can to tell everyone about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For the sake of Arisa and everyone else who will be appearing alongside us, I...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, the bath's ready. Do you want first dibs?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii.
Um... Why don't you go first?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you sure? Well, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Were you going over the script just now...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, since our shoot is just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm... I see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I assume... Someone who you don't exactly see eye to eye with is also gonna be there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. How did you know, Shii...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't say much since it hasn't aired yet, but some people from Cheerful * Days are going to be there... People who I caused quite a bit of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For their sake, I was trying to motivate myself to absolutely make sure that our shoot goes well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not really in a position to really say anything, but I think you'll be fine. Besides, Momoi and the others are gonna be there with you too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii, that's so sweet of you!
I feel much better already...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no...! Shii, why are you running away?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because I don't want you invading my personal space.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't give me that look.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna go take my bath...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii, wait.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No means no.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's not that. Yes, it's unfortunate that you're not letting me hug you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, instead, I'd like to make a quick declaration of my intentions...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A declaration of your intentions?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You mentioned how I'll be surrounded by friends during the day of...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But my goal is to do my best to stand under my own power.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They all did so much for me, so I'd like to give back to them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'm going to do my best to make our appearance as entertaining as possible by telling my story using my own words.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nice. I like that.
So, does that mean you have a plan ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Well...
I certainly feel ready to make what I said a reality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That should be more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You seem to really want to do this and it's your decision, so I say go for it. Have confidence in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...!
Thank you, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Anyway, I'm gonna go take my bath.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Shii.
I promise to do my best while having confidence in my decision.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us for another MORE MORE JUMP! livestream!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Finally! Hi, Shizuku!>
<Hello!>
<Congrats on your TV appearance!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it sounds like some of your fans want to jump right in with our TV appearance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Who here saw us on idol Hazard?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I did! It was so awesome!>
<I was cracking up because you were such a nervous wreck, Minori.>
<I learned about your streams on iHaz!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! So many comments!
They really saw us on TV!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And some seem to be watching for the first time after seeing us on iHaz. Thank you all for joining us. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, there's way more people here than usual today.>
<Welcome newbies!>
<MMJ's the best...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, we'd like to thank everyone who sent us messages and such after it aired.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, for today's stream, we'll be discussing what happened on iHaz.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's right!
We're calling this the “Top Secret iHaz Talk Show☆”!!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, does that mean we get to hear what happened behind the scenes?>
<Cool! Tell us more!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't we start by asking Minori how things went after stuffing her face with snacks in the green room and tensing up way too much during the shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A-Airi...!
They don't need to know about what I ate!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She stuffed her face lol.>
<That's Minori for you! What did they serve?>
<Yeah, tell us!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys wanna know?
Then, I'll describe the green room while talking more about how the shoot went!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As a result, I froze up a few times... But I talked it over with Haruka afterwards, so I promise to do better next time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori...
Next...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your turn, Shizuku!>
<How'd it go for you, Shizuku?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, they want to hear from you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You did receive a huge wave of support after it aired, so it makes sense that they want to hear what you have to say about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, mind going next for us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How did it go...? To summarize briefly, I was very nervous the entire time...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, you were too?>
<Yeah. After all, Cheerful * Days was there.>
<Totally understandable. I was really afraid of what Arisa was gonna say.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As I mentioned during our shoot, I was given a script each time I made an appearance when I was still in Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And the others would dive in to rescue me whenever I had to go off-script...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Again, I ended up being a terrible lead.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, that's why I felt motivated to do my best for this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't want to depend on a script or use my friends as a crutch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wanted to show Arisa, the others and everybody watching that I've grown as an idol and can stand on my own now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And to say, “Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<We heard you loud and clear, Shizuku!>
<Seeing you on TV made me so happy to be your fan!>
<I promise to follow you forever!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our stream went really well today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was our first one after appearing on TV. Still, it was nice to see so many new people joining us for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we got a ton of new subscribers. That means our archived streams should get even more views...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi...?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This comment... I think it's a message for you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Dear Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I was a huge admirer of the mysterious and perfect version of you from when you were still with Cheerful * Days.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Which is why I had trouble accepting the MORE MORE JUMP! version of you... I actually stopped being your fan for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <But what you said on iHaz made me realize that you're still that person I admired so much.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm sorry for losing faith in you and even hating you for a bit. But, I hope you'll welcome me back as your fan.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This comment... I'm starting to tear up...! I'm so happy for you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(What I said... How I really feel...
They really heard me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (There may be others who felt the same thing as this person...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if I can keep reaching out to them one by one, I may be able to help them heal.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I need to make each word I say count moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For the sake of my old fans, as well as those who've accepted me as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We can check off the meeting for that radio program now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The producer seemed like such a nice person too. They did a wonderful job of explaining everything and answered our questions thoroughly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we have a much better idea of what they want us to do and how we need to prepare for it now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, do you have notes ready for Haruka and Minori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, they're ready. I'm glad we split the work by having you talk and me jotting everything down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but I would like you to take a look at them later to make sure I didn't miss anything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing... Hmm... Next, we're supposed to have a meeting at a cafe with the people from that magazine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're probably gonna get there pretty early now, but we could look those over while we wait...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, um... It's just...
That Japanese confectionary shop caught my eye...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... “Adorable animal confections now on sale”...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, wow! Airi, look...!
They have cats, dogs, rabbits and all these other little animals! How cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can see that. I see them, but...
We still have work to do. We don't really have time for this right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, we're not going...
That's just that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She looks so eager to go...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, Airi? Didn't you just say that we'd have a lot of time on our hands if we went over to the cafe now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And wouldn't it be better to look over my notes now as opposed to after we got to the cafe?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: T-True...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See? So, why don't we stop by this shop? They even seem to have a seated porch area that looks very nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Grr... I was trying to resist that temptation...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku. Then, let's look through your notes over some Japanese sweets.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Here is your matcha and sweets set.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, the kitten manju you got looks so cute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? After I saw those little round eyes looking at me, I couldn't not order it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But it needs to be eaten...
Oh no, I'm becoming more attached to it by the second.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You did spend quite a long time deciding which one to get.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But the rabbit daifuku you got's also really cute, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I particularly like how the mochi really makes it look like a fluffy rabbit. The red eyes are also a wonderful touch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Aren't you gonna eat yours, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I could ask you the same thing, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, we've just gotta do it...!
Hiya!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no...! Your cat's face! It's been split in half...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nom...
Mmm... Sho good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I'll... I'm so sorry, Mr. Rabbit... Forgive me...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Mmm...!
This rabbit's so delicious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't say that! Say you're eating a daifuku! Imagine if someone heard you saying that out of context!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, I didn't realize you could turn Japanese sweets into such cute animals...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and a huge variety of them too. What else was there...? Bears, chickens and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Pandas...and penguins.
Hehe. I'm sure Haruka would've chosen that one if she were here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Definitely! Oh, what about Minori? A dog?
But it was a Shiba... Would she not choose it since it's not a Samoyed?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... I wish she could've been here with us. Then we would know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But she probably has class right about now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a little lonely without the others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Airi...?
How would you feel about us buying some souvenirs for them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The next time we see them, we can give them some sweets along with our notes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could say that you spotted this Japanese confectionary shop when we were on our way to a meeting...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And how we began wondering which animals they would've chosen if they were also there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Telling them about not just work but also what we discovered and talked about would help include them and remedy this feeling of loneliness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure they also feel a little guilty about not being able to work because of school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Having some of these adorable sweets should help cheer them up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's buy some that we think they'll really enjoy on our way back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But first, we're taking a look at those notes you just took!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay♪
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, do you remember our schedule for today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we have that meeting in the afternoon. When did you want to leave school?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we can leave after our next class ends... That should give us plenty of time to get to where we're going.

Wow!

Mind smiling the same way for us as the candy version of you?

Hehe.

rows.Line: Hehe. They seem to be having fun.

rows.Line: (What should I do...?)

rows.Line: Wait, Airi, you're not going to be on any committees?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Line: I understand that it's important to be an active participant at school, but I believe we're all free to enjoy our life as students however we like.

rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Being on the cleanup committee had been a lot of fun. If possible, I'd like to at least continue being a part of some committee.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I just hope that I can make the same arrangement as Minori and not cause the other members too much trouble...)

rows.Line: (The library committee... No, that involves lending out books during lunch and helping keep all the shelves sorted.)

rows.Line: (I should be able to make the cleanup committee work since I somehow managed last year...)

rows.Line: (But this could also be my chance to be on a different committee...)

Rooftop

rows.Line: Yes. I'll also be responsible for refilling the soap around the sinks and helping take measurements during checkups.

rows.Line: I was somewhat interested in joining the broadcasting committee or being a class representative, but I wanted to join a committee that I'm more certain I can make the time for.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why you chose the health committee. I actually think it suits you the most, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyone who's not feeling well is gonna immediately feel better after you rub their back and tell them that they're gonna be okay!

rows.Line: Hmm... You sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm certain!
I mean, just think about it!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I don't feel so good...

rows.Line:
Oh dear.

rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Line: I'm not sure about that...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: You're supposed to meet in Akasaka for FluffTalk, but Yokohama for LoVE IDoL... Will you be able to make it to this interview in time?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness Saito caught that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito seemed like she was hurting somehow...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She was acting cheerfully, but I'm worried that something's really bothering her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'd like to be there for her if I can.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Especially since Saito's been such a huge source of support for us up to this point.)

rows.Line: I see... A better way for the four of you to manage your schedule.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. As grateful as we are about receiving all these offers, it's been getting harder and harder for us to stay on top of everything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why we were wondering if there was a better way.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, there's actually an app that I really recommend!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An app?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, it's this...
It has a user-friendly design, and it makes it easy to share updates with each other.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Interesting... Yeah, it does have a nice interface. It's good how you can switch the calendar between days and months in an instant.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can even see who made changes to what.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Personally, I think the best thing about this app is how it lets you customize everything however you like.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: For example, you can place a stamp on a calendar item, like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, that's so cute! It has a cat stamp on it now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And there are so many other stamps.
This way, you can get an idea of what kind of plan it is just by looking at the stamp.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're all showing so much interest. Please give it a try. I should also be able to answer any questions that come up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, we really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, I had no idea that such a handy app existed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Where do you usually learn about apps like this?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Where...?
I tried a bunch of scheduling apps while looking for one that I felt was easy to use.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I think I went through about ten or so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, that many?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Y-Yes. Things started getting a little hectic for me after I started my part-time job...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Which is why I spent a lot of time looking for a scheduling app that worked for me.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I was astonished when I found this one. It has so many different features, and it's so easy to edit things!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm even thinking about using this app if I land a job being someone's manager.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, again, I really recommend it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you become someone's manager...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see. It's wonderful how you're working so hard towards your dream.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: N-No... I'm nowhere near making it come true yet.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In any case, I'm really glad that I could help!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She seems to find genuine pleasure in seeing MORE MORE JUMP! succeed. Almost as if she were going through it all alongside us.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But she is an invaluable partner. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's one of my biggest fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which is why I can't just leave things be when I see that something's bothering her.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I should set aside some time to talk with her once we're done with this shoot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll actually be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Regardless, I want to be there for her. That fact isn't about to change.
