rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now, it's time to play...
Survival Camp! The fun and exciting game where you don't know what tools you're gonna get!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Haruka & Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're splitting into pairs by drawing names from a hat, and then making curry in those pairs, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! Fortune has placed Shizuku and Haruka in one pair, with myself and Minori in the other.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi and I will be making the curry!
That means you and Haruka will be making the rice, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. Each pair has also been given a set of tools for chopping wood and starting a fire.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We get to use modern tools for chopping firewood and lighting fires.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We got an axe and...a strap drill.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What's a strap drill...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Basically, we have to spin a stick on a piece of wood to create enough friction to start a fire!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, we need to sandwich the stick vertically between two pieces of wood. Then, one of us will press down and hold the stick in place, while the other spins it by pulling on each end of the string wrapped around it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As it spins, the stick will heat up the wood on the bottom and create some tiny embers. In other words...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is gonna take a ton of time and effort!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
E-Eeeeepp...!
How did we end up with this?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this is a tool that needs two people to work as a team. S-So, you and I should be able to start a fire using this no problem!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You sound so excited, Minori.
Shall we also start getting ready, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. We can't let those two steal the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we break into our pairs and get started?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna do our best and make the best curry we can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, Shizuku, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, starting with our firewood!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I always thought that chopping firewood involved splitting logs with an axe on top of a big wide log... But we get to use this handy tool today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. It's apparently designed to make the process a lot easier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's shaped like a cylinder... How do you think we're supposed to use it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Here, let me show you.
You put it on the ground with the blade facing upward, and you place a log on top of it inside the frame.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, just hit the top of the log with a hammer and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's incredible! It split them so quickly...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Easy, right?
It's your turn next. Do you feel ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I should be fine as long as I do what you just did. So, I place a log on the blade and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow...! Haruka, I did it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice job.
Let's maintain this energy and keep chopping more wood.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka, look! I made some really thin pieces!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow, that's pretty cool.
And we have so much now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was a little worried at first since I'm not very strong, but this makes everything so fun and easy♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that we have such a big pile, I think we can move on to starting our fire.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Starting our fire... That involves using that modern tool, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, this tool here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a metal stick and a plate...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're called the rod and the striker. By hitting the rod hard with the striker, you get...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Sparks...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's amazing, Haruka. How do you know all this? Have you done this before by any chance?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned how to use tools like this way back when I was on this one survival program.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While you have the chance, Shizuku, why don't you give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure? I don't know if I'll be able to use them correctly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't worry. Just do what I just did.
Scrape the two pieces against each other to create some sparks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Scrape the two pieces together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nothing happened...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You may need to use a little more force.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you're holding back a little because you're unconsciously afraid of the sparks going everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... You may be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll give it another try.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More! Force!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: S-Still nothing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you still seem to be holding back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Try to give it everything you have.
You don't have to worry about it exploding or anything. Also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whether or not we get to have our curry depends on you right now, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our curry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: R-Right...! If I can't get our fire started, we won't be able to cook any rice...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll give it everything I have.
Watch me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Start!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I did it... I did it, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Way to go, Shizuku!
Now we can start cooking the rice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I did it... I started this fire...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Alone, I always thought that I couldn't do anything, but I've gotten to experience so many new things working with the others...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's so wonderful how I'm learning to do more and more.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, our fire's holding. Let's start getting the rice ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We need to make our rice as delicious as we can for the others' sake.

(What about a three-leaf clover?
It'd even give me a chance to explain how it represents our group.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And it'd be so cute if I made some in all of our colors.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Hehe. Let's do that.
I'll even make them big so that everyone can see...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, wait, the stream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness. Someone else is being shown right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to take this opportunity to surprise everyone... So I'll need to be careful about not getting caught on camera.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to focus and do my best to make sure everything turns out well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Cut the thread, and...
Phew... It's finished.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad they turned out so well.
I should have Minori and the others look at these later.

rows.Line: Hi, Shizuku. Is your embroidery done?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haruka...!
Look at the clovers I just embroidered.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, these look really nice.
It's incredible how precisely you made them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I can't wait to show these to our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, I had a feeling that you hadn't noticed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look at that monitor over there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That monitor...? Oh...!

<She finally noticed lol>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I honestly had no idea...
How long have I been on?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'd say about five minutes.
I learned that you were here from the stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, five minutes...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so sorry for not noticing sooner, everyone. Watching me do such a repetitive task must not have been very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You looked like a work of art.>
<I could watch you do that forever.>
<I wanna see what you were embroidering!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, yes. I can show all of you right now.
Can you all see what I'm holding?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<No, I can't see...>
<That's not where the camera is, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Showing the monitor won't let them see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I'm so sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That's our Shizuku.>
<Business as usual again today.>
<Is Shizuku actually a bit of an airhead?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Umm... The camera's over here, yes?
Can you all see now?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wow, those are so cute...!>
<You really made these?>
<You're so talented. Respect.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But this is actually much easier than it looks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know. Why don't we all try doing this together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I ran an embroidery class on the MORE MORE JUMP! stream a little while back, and we all had a lot of fun that time.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Another embroidery class?!>
<I've never done it before, but it looks fun!>
<Teach me, Ms. Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you hold your class, I might participate as a student.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and we can create something together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll let you all know when we've figured out a date for that stream. Hehe. I'm looking forward to it already.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What a beautiful day.
The sun feels amazing, and this is perfect weather for a picnic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. On the other hand, we might be in too urban a setting to call this a picnic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's nice to have lunch on the rooftop like this since it's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ever since the Lumina Grand Prix started, we've been spending a lot fewer days at school.
<Can we talk for a second, girls?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Luka! What do you wanna talk about?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I came over to ask if those black fragments had caused any lingering aftereffects.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see.
Thank you for showing us so much concern, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Aftereffects...
I haven't been feeling any. How about the rest of you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<That's good to hear.
Are you all about to have lunch?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We were all scheduled to come to school today, so Shizuku asked if we'd all like to have lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. After having that dream, I felt like coming back up here with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did dance up here during that dream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. I began feeling all of this nostalgia about all of the things that happened up here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
Everything also began rushing back for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That includes dancing up here all by myself. And I met you for the first time up here, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I remember.
I accidentally walked in on Airi and Shizuku having an argument.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In retrospect, the way we met was hardly ideal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, we began practicing together, and we ended up forming MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We even did our very first stream up here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There was so much trial and error in the beginning. Remember how many discussions we had about what we'd be actually doing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... That really takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Back then, I really had no idea how to present myself to the public...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I ended up causing you all so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I was so convinced that I had to keep being “perfect” in order to satisfy my old fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm willing to bet there are plenty of people out there who would support you for who you are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I think you might know one of them.
Her name is Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She loves both the Shizuku from Cheerful * Days and the Shizuku she's gotten to know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should've seen how passionate she was when she started talking about how much she wants your fans to know just how amazing you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm able to show everyone who I really am because of all your encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If that stream never happened, then I might've just kept on trying to be that perfect version of myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I would've been like the me from that dream. I probably would've kept telling myself to be the person that everybody wanted me to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, allow me to take this opportunity to say it again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for what you did for me back then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe! We're also glad that we were able to learn how wonderful a person you really are, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I also feel that way.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I love how you're such a hard-working girl who's a little absent-minded at times, but also very cute♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, Shizuku, just keep being yourself and keep spreading hope to lots and lots of people.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I will...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I didn't mean to dominate the conversation like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, it's nice to reminisce.
I'm really enjoying all this nostalgia.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now we've started, why don't we talk about all the other stuff we've done up here while we eat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to hear what you all have to say.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to start us off!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're gonna talk about Haruka, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Because of it's you, Minori. But...I am curious as to what memories you're going to talk about.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, please tell us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You got it!
This is a story that happened a long, long time ago when Haruka and I walked home for the first time.
